title: Manager - Controls & PLC
description:
**Job Purpose-**

The Lead - Electrical drives the design, integration, and validation of turbine electrical systems, ensuring high performance, reliability, and compliance with industry standards. The role focuses on SCADA integration, subsystem validation, thermal management, and power quality optimization, addressing compatibility challenges and ensuring efficient load distribution. It leads the testing and maintenance of critical components like converters, transformers, and generators to align with performance goals. The role supports field operations, conducts root cause analyses for subsystem failures, and implements corrective actions to improve reliability. Additionally, it collaborates with cross-functional teams to refine designs and ensure manufacturability, contributing to long-term operational efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities of Role-**

* Development and tuning of control algorithms.
* Implementation of control algorithms in MATLAB/Simulink.
* Simulate software in hardware in loop (HIL) or Software in loop (SIL)
* Able to simulate grid fault related in simulation runs in control algorithm.
* Control performance data analysis in turbine/fleet level controller tuning and optimization
* Execute wind turbine controls system and software development
* Perform Failure Mode and Effects Analysis and develop comprehensive requirements for wind turbine software features and components
* Develop test cases and perform controls software validation
* Be responsible for technical design of wind turbine controls hardware, including sensors (temperature, proximity, vibration, etc.), I/O, and communication equipment
* Able to validate control logics through field tests, conclude on the design aspects
* Create engineering documentation, including bills of material, drawings, specifications, and manufacturing & field instructions
* Occasionally travel to site to support product testing and/or customer issues
* Having Power system background would be added advantage to this role to support on Grid compliance requirements.
* Highly motivated, self-starter, energetic, positive, flexible in changing environments.
* Ability to demonstrate a structured approach to problem solving, learning agility.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to articulate technical problems in clear and simple terms.
* Strong interpersonal skills, ability to work in project teams in an international environment.
* Solid understanding of programming basics
* Experience in one of more of the following areas demonstrated through course work, internships, or other experiences: control systems and algorithm design, software development for embedded systems, PLC platforms and communication protocols, sensors, signal processing
* Wind Turbine Technology Experience is a strong plus but not required
* Experience in any of the following adjacent fields: Power Systems, Multi-Body Dynamics, Data Science, Systems Engineering, SW Development Methods such as Verification & Validation, version control, DevOps
* Experience with Model-Based Design techniques using Mathworks Simulink or comparable tool
* Passionate about renewable energy and/or sustainability.

**Educational Background-**

* BE in Electrical Engineering or related discipline.

**Work Experience-**

* 8 to 12 years

**Industry Knowledge-**

* Expertise in load management, harmonics mitigation, and SCADA systems. Familiarity with IEC standards and advanced simulation tools is required.

**Additional Requirements-**

Must have Experience with Bachmann OR Beckhoff PLC platforms is preferred.

title: Senior Principal Consultant – TSU Manager (Team Leader)
description:
SkyQuest is seeking a senior programme leader to manage a 24-month technical assistance programme supporting a national agricultural development finance institution in Nigeria. The programme aims to strengthen the Institution’s ability to mobilise and deploy capital to agricultural enterprises and organisations serving smallholder farmers, particularly women and underserved producers.

About the role

The TSU Manager will lead a multidisciplinary Technical Support Unit (TSU) and act as the central integration point between the Institution’s CEO and executive management, the funding partner and specialist teams. The role is accountable for programme governance, strategic coherence, executive and Board engagement, delivery oversight and the quality of programme deliverables.

Key responsibilities

* Lead programme governance, integrated planning, decision-making, escalation, risk and issue management, and formal phase-gate reviews.
* Manage a multidisciplinary team of specialist leads; set accountabilities, allocate work, monitor delivery and review all deliverables before submission.
* Serve as the principal counterpart to the Institution’s CEO and executive management and the primary point of contact for the funding partner.
* Lead executive validation sessions, strategic reviews and Board presentations, subject to CEO approval.
* Direct the institutional diagnostic, maturity assessment, prioritisation process and development of a resourced implementation plan.
* Integrate specialist work across agricultural finance and credit risk, technology and data, agribusiness investment readiness, blended-finance capital mobilisation and climate finance.
* Oversee design and testing of a multi-source financing facility, including capital structure, blended-capital architecture, financing documentation and mobilisation strategy.
* Ensure pilots are evidence-based, evaluated and refined, with clear benefits for organisations serving smallholder farmers.
* Lead programme performance management, monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL), quarterly reviews and the formal mid-term review.
* Oversee institutionalisation, capability transfer and handover of validated policies, tools, models, SOPs and operating arrangements to named Institution owners.

Qualifications and experience

**Education:**
Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Agricultural Economics, Development Studies, Business Administration or a related field. CFA, ACCA, ICAN, PMP/PRINCE2 or equivalent is an advantage.

· 16+ years in development finance, agricultural finance, financial-institution advisory or large technical assistance programmes.

·       Substantial hands-on experience in agricultural lending and agri-finance, including credit appraisal, risk assessment and portfolio management.

· At least 8 years leading multidisciplinary teams on complex, multi-stakeholder programmes as Team Leader, Programme Director or equivalent.

· Experience advising CEOs, executive committees and Boards of banks, DFIs or public financial institutions.

· Track record leading assignments for development partners such as the World Bank Group, AfDB, FCDO, major philanthropic foundations or similar.

· Proven delivery of institutional transformation programmes that were successfully handed over to the client institution.

· Strong programme governance, integrated planning, dependency and risk management, and results-based management skills.

· Sound understanding of DFI operating models and blended-finance instruments.

**Desirable:**
Experience with Nigerian or Sub-Saharan African DFIs; facility or fund design; investor or lender engagement; MEL; gender-inclusive finance; and smallholder-focused impact measurement. Hausa, Yoruba or Igbo is an advantage.

title: AI Scientific Editor - Neuroscience and Neurology (Work-from-home)

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.
  
  
Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride. 
  
  
**Role at Baxter:**
As a member of the Global Pharmaceutical R&D (GPRD) Complex Product Development team, you will lead and execute analytical activities supporting the development of complex injectable products, including peptides and iron-based formulations. You will be responsible for analytical method development, validation, technology transfer, stability studies, and regulatory support while ensuring compliance with GxP (Good “x” Practice), GDP (Good Documentation Practices) and global quality standards. This role is critical in driving product development, regulatory submissions, and lifecycle management across Baxter's global portfolio.
  
  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Execute analytical method development, pre-validation, validation, and technology transfer activities for complex injectable drug products.
* Perform testing and characterization of APIs, drug products, stability samples, development batches, validation batches, and reference listed drugs (RLDs).
* Support regulatory submissions by generating analytical data and responding to regulatory queries.
* Develop and review analytical reports, SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), methods of analysis (MOAs), protocols, and laboratory documentation.
* Conduct analytical investigations related to OOS, OOT, deviations, non-conformances, and laboratory abnormalities.
* Perform routine operation, calibration review, qualification support, and troubleshooting of analytical instruments.
* Execute and interpret complex analytical techniques relevant to peptides and iron colloidal drug products.
* Support preventive maintenance, risk assessments, and corrective actions for laboratory equipment and systems.
* Ensure accurate data recording in ELN and compliance with GxP, GDP, ALCOA++, ICH guidelines, and pharmacopoeial requirements.
* Review stability programs, qualification documents, data logger reports, and vendor documentation.
* Manage API and excipient vendor approval activities and review Drug Master Files (DMFs).
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, contract manufacturing sites, suppliers, and global stakeholders to meet project timelines.


**What You'll Bring:**

* Masters degree with at least 5-8 years, or PhD with 4-6 years in relevant discipline required.

* Significant experience in pharmaceutical analytical development within complex injectables, sterile products, or parenteral formulations.
* Hands-on expertise in analytical method development, validation, technology transfer, and stability studies.
* Experience supporting regulatory submissions for global markets.

* Strong experience with peptide and iron colloidal drug product analysis.
* Knowledge of particle size distribution techniques including Gel Filtration Chromatography (GFC), light scattering, diffraction, and obscuration methods.
* Experience with iron speciation assays including ferrous, ferric, labile iron, chelation assays, reduction potential, and kinetics studies.
* Working knowledge of analytical techniques used for complex injectable products.
* Strong understanding of ICH Guidelines, pharmacopoeial requirements, Good Laboratory Practices (GLP), Good Documentation Practices (GDP), and GxP regulations.
* Experience using laboratory electronic systems such as ELN, TrackWise, TCU, and related quality management systems.

title: Senior Proposal Writer
description:
**Role**
We are looking for someone who can do much more than write grammatically correct paragraphs. A winning proposal writer understands what the evaluator is asking, why they are asking it, what evidence will make the response credible and how to make the answer easy to score. You should be willing to tell an SME, 'This technically answers the question, but it will not win us points - we need to make it stronger.' You should be comfortable starting with a blank page, interviewing busy subject-matter experts, challenging vague statements, finding proof for claims and turning fragmented input into a clear and compelling story. Most importantly, we want someone who treats the final submission as their personal product.
  
  
Proposal Development
  
  

* Analyze RFPs, RFQs and RFIs and translate requirements into compliant response structures.
* Develop proposal outlines, compliance matrices and writing plans.
* Draft and edit executive summaries, technical approaches, management plans, transition plans, implementation approaches, staffing plans, quality-management approaches, past performance, corporate experience and other response sections.
* Adapt content to the agency and requirement rather than relying on generic boilerplate.

SME Collaboration
  
  

* Conduct focused interviews with technical, delivery, recruiting, finance and management SMEs.
* Translate technical concepts into clear evaluator-friendly language.
* Identify unanswered requirements, unsupported claims and weak differentiators.
* Own follow-ups required to complete assigned sections.

Proposal Strategy & Review
  
  

* Apply established win themes, differentiators and customer priorities throughout the response.
* Connect features to customer outcomes and measurable benefits.
* Participate in structured reviews and incorporate feedback quickly.
* Perform compliance, consistency and quality checks, including contradictions between technical, management, staffing, schedule and pricing narratives.

Content Library
  
  

* Develop and continuously improve reusable proposal content.
* Maintain past-performance narratives, case studies, corporate qualifications and recurring technical/management responses.
* Retire outdated or weak content rather than blindly reusing it.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Provide day-to-day writing guidance and coaching to the existing Proposal Writer.
* Establish writing examples and quality standards.
* Help improve the team's ability to write concise, persuasive and evaluator-friendly responses.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* 4-7 years of professional proposal-writing experience.
* Direct experience responding to U.S. government RFPs; SLED experience strongly preferred.
* Excellent U.S. business English and professional editing ability.
* Demonstrated experience with compliance-driven proposals, compliance matrices and structured response outlines.
* Ability to understand IT and professional-services concepts sufficiently to write credible technical content.
* Strong research and interviewing skills and ability to manage multiple deadlines.

**Preferred Qualifications / Experience**

* APMP certification.
* Experience in IT services, staffing, cloud, data, AI, application modernization, cybersecurity or digital transformation.
* Experience writing both staff-augmentation and deliverables/solution-based proposals.
* Experience supporting oral presentations or interviews.
* Familiarity with responsible use of generative AI for proposal productivity.

The Personality We Are Looking For
  
  

* Takes pride in the final product and notices details other people overlook.
* Does not accept vague SME answers just because the SME is senior.
* Is comfortable rewriting their own work repeatedly.
* Understands that compliant is the minimum bar, not the definition of a winning proposal.
* Works calmly under pressure and takes feedback professionally.
* Helps junior team members become better rather than protecting knowledge.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
Within the first 90 days, this person should materially improve first-draft quality, evaluator focus, consistency and reusable content, while beginning to coach the existing writer toward a stronger proposal-writing standard.

title: Manager - Technical Bid & Solution
description:
**Role**
This is not a traditional Project Manager position. We are not looking for someone whose primary strength is maintaining Jira boards, scheduling meetings or updating project plans. We need someone who can read a 150-page government RFP and determine what Dash would actually have to build, migrate, integrate, test, deploy, support and manage if we win. The ideal person can move comfortably between technical and business conversations, challenge unrealistic assumptions, coordinate architects and engineers, build a credible delivery plan and make sure the proposal never promises something the delivery team cannot execute.
  
  
Technical RFP Analysis
  
  

* Analyze technical RFP requirements and decompose them into capabilities, workstreams, deliverables and dependencies.
* Identify mandatory technical requirements, integrations, security requirements, environments, data considerations, service levels and implementation constraints.
* Develop technical questions and clarification requests where requirements are ambiguous.

Solution Shaping
  
  

* Facilitate solution workshops with architects, developers, cloud/data specialists, project managers and other SMEs.
* Develop credible solution approaches for custom application development, modernization, cloud, data, AI, integration and managed-service engagements.
* Define scope boundaries, assumptions, dependencies and exclusions.
* Ensure proposed solutions are practical, supportable and aligned with Dash delivery capabilities.

Estimation & Delivery Planning
  
  

* Develop or coordinate work breakdown structures, staffing models, schedules, milestones and effort estimates.
* Validate whether the proposed team can realistically deliver within the requested schedule.
* Identify delivery risks and mitigation strategies and support pricing teams with clear resource, effort and timeline assumptions.

Technical Proposal Development
  
  

* Own or co-author technical approaches, implementation plans, transition plans, architecture narratives, project-management approaches and related proposal sections.
* Provide technical input to graphics, diagrams and solution architecture.
* Review technical proposal sections for accuracy, consistency and credibility.
* Participate in technical Red Team reviews.

Presentations & Pursuit-to-Delivery Continuity
  
  

* Support oral presentations, technical demonstrations, solution-defense sessions and clarification responses.
* Lead structured technical handoff after award so delivery receives proposal assumptions, commitments, staffing models, milestones and risks.
* Track lessons learned from actual project delivery and feed them back into future estimates and proposal approaches.

Reusable Solution Assets
  
  

* Develop reusable reference approaches for recurring SLED opportunities.
* Maintain solution patterns, estimation assumptions, team models and implementation approaches that can accelerate future pursuits.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* 7-10+ years of experience across IT delivery, architecture, technical presales, solution consulting, bid management or technical project leadership.
* At least 3 years of meaningful involvement in RFP/RFI responses, presales or solutioning.
* Strong understanding of modern application development, cloud, integration, data and enterprise technology delivery.
* Ability to estimate teams, effort, timelines and implementation dependencies.
* Strong understanding of project risks, assumptions and delivery governance.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong professional writing and presentation skills and willingness to challenge unrealistic assumptions.

**Preferred Qualifications / Experience**

* U.S. public-sector or government-bid experience.
* Experience with Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
* PMP, Scrum, SAFe, cloud or architecture certifications.
* Experience with AI/ML, data platforms, application modernization or systems integration.
* Experience supporting fixed-price or deliverables-based IT services proposals.

The Personality We Are Looking For
  
  

* Wants to understand how things actually work rather than repeating buzzwords.

title: Tender Executive
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive
**Tender Executive**
to identify relevant government and private-sector tenders, prepare and submit bids, and manage e-procurement portals. The candidate will be responsible for tracking tender opportunities related to e-waste recycling, waste management, scrap disposal, EPR compliance, reverse logistics, and environmental services.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have prior experience in tender management, bid documentation, government procurement portals, and online tender submission processes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Tender Identification and Monitoring
* Regularly monitor government and public-sector tender portals, including GeM (Government e-Marketplace), CPPP, state e-procurement portals, and relevant private-sector platforms.
* Identify suitable tender opportunities related to e-waste collection, recycling, disposal, EPR compliance, scrap disposal, reverse logistics, and waste management.
* Evaluate tender eligibility, scope of work, submission deadlines, Earnest Money Deposit (EMD), tender fees, turnover requirements, experience criteria, and technical specifications.
* Maintain a structured tender tracker covering upcoming, active, submitted, and awarded tenders.
* Track tender amendments, corrigenda, pre-bid meetings, and deadline extensions.
* Tender Documentation and Bid Preparation
* Prepare and compile technical bids, financial bids, commercial proposals, and supporting documentation.
* Draft covering letters, declarations, undertakings, compliance statements, and other documents required by tendering authorities.
* Coordinate the collection and verification of company documents, including GST registration, PAN, CIN, audited financial statements, turnover certificates, work orders, experience certificates, and statutory records.
* Review tender conditions and ensure that all eligibility and documentation requirements are fulfilled before submission.
* Identify deviations, risks, missing documents, and compliance gaps, and escalate them to the concerned team before bid submission.
* Coordinate with internal departments to obtain technical, financial, and operational information required for preparing competitive bids.
* E-Procurement Portal Management
* Register and maintain company profiles on GeM, CPPP, state e-procurement portals, and other relevant procurement platforms.
* Manage Digital Signature Certificates (DSCs) and portal credentials securely.
* Upload tender documents, submit online bids, and complete all required e-procurement formalities within prescribed deadlines.
* Monitor portal notifications, technical clarifications, bid opening updates, and submission acknowledgements.
* Maintain organized records of tender documents, submission receipts, bid status, and related correspondence.
* Tender Pipeline and Reporting
* Maintain an updated database of tender opportunities, eligibility status, submission timelines, and outcomes.
* Prepare periodic reports on tenders identified, bids submitted, pending actions, and tenders awarded or rejected.
* Coordinate with management to prioritize suitable opportunities based on eligibility, commercial viability, and business requirements.
* Follow up on tender results, requests for clarification, technical evaluations, and financial bid openings.
* Maintain a systematic digital repository of tender-related documents for future reference.

**Required Qualifications And Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in tender management, bid coordination, or e-procurement operations.
* Practical knowledge of GeM, CPPP, and/or state government e-procurement portals.
* Experience in preparing technical bids, financial bids, compliance documents, and commercial proposals.
* Understanding of tender eligibility criteria, EMD, tender fees, turnover requirements, and bid submission procedures.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel, MS Word, and document management.
* Strong attention to detail, documentation, coordination, and deadline management.
* Good written communication skills and the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external authorities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience handling tenders related to e-waste recycling, scrap disposal, waste management, environmental services, or reverse logistics.
* Familiarity with EPR compliance, CPCB requirements, and relevant waste management regulations.
* Experience with government departments, PSUs, municipal corporations, industrial organizations, or institutional procurement.
* Knowledge of DSC-based online bid submission and tender portal registrations.

Skills: e-procurement,government e-procurement portals,tender compliance,tender management,tender fee management,cppp,bid preparation,financial bids,gem,tender documentation

title: Factory Operations Consultant
description:
**Company Description**

91 Blackboard trains, coaches, and supports clients as they navigate digital transformation, economic shifts, market disruption, and evolving business environments. The company focuses on exploring and proposing strategic options that help organizations adapt and thrive in changing conditions. By combining practical training with rigorous analysis, 91 Blackboard develops creative strategies that deliver sustainable value. Its approach emphasizes long-term impact, operational excellence, and measurable results for clients.

**Role Description<

/strong>

The Operations Consultant( Manufacturing) is a full-time, on-site role based in the
**Greater Ahmedabad /Surat Area**
. This role involves assessing existing factory operations, identifying process bottlenecks, and recommending improvements in production, quality, and efficiency. The consultant will collaborate with plant leadership and cross-functional teams to design and implement operational strategies, standardize procedures, and monitor performance metrics. Daily responsibilities include conducting data-driven analyses, facilitating workshops and training sessions, preparing reports and presentations, and supporting change management initiatives. The role also requires regular interaction with client stakeholders to understand business goals, address operational challenges, and ensure successful implementation of recommended solutions.

**Roles and Responsibility**

• Assess manufacturing processes, workflows, capacity, bottlenecks, PPC systems, and operational performance.

• Improve productivity, machine and manpower utilisation, throughput, schedule adherence, on-time delivery, and waste reduction.

• Standardise SOPs, work instructions, inspection formats, and process controls across key factory functions.

• Implement ISO 9001:2015, TQM, Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, PDCA, and continuous improvement systems.

• Conduct gap assessments, process audits, documentation reviews, compliance tracking, and audit preparation.

• Lead root-cause analysis, CAPA, non-conformance management, defect and rejection analysis, rework reduction, and customer complaint resolution.

• Establish cross-functional quality ownership, improvement teams, and structured problem-solving practices.

• Develop departmental KRAs, KPIs, targets, dashboards, and daily, weekly, and monthly performance reviews.

• Track OEE, productivity, downtime, rejection, rework, inventory accuracy, schedule adherence, and on-time delivery.

• Conduct factory visits, stakeholder interviews, process observations, and operational audits.

• Prepare AS-IS assessments, gap analyses, TO-BE models, and implementation roadmaps with clear owners, timelines, and outcomes.

• Facilitate workshops, coach client teams, monitor implementation, and ensure recommendations deliver sustained factory-level improvements.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

• Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Mechanical, Industrial, Production, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline.

• 5–10 years of experience in manufacturing operations, industrial engineering, quality management, operational excellence, or related consulting.

• Practical experience implementing ISO 9001:2015, conducting internal audits, and developing QMS documentation.

• Experience with TQM, Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, PDCA, CAPA, root-cause analysis, production planning, and manufacturing KPI systems.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

• Willingness to travel to client factories and work hands-on with shop-floor teams.

**Preferred Certifications**

• ISO 9001:2015 Internal Auditor or Lead Auditor.

• Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma Green Belt.

• TQM, operational excellence, or continuous improvement certification.

**Success Measures**

• Achievement of agreed ISO and TQM implementation milestones.

• Improved production efficiency, schedule adherence, throughput, and on-time delivery.

• Reduced rejection, rework, scrap, downtime, and operational waste.

• Improved compliance with SOPs, quality procedures, and process controls.

• Reliable departmental KPI dashboards and performance-review systems.

• Sustained adoption of improvement initiatives by client teams.

title: Calibration Engineer - Ahmedabad
description:
Role: Calibration Engineer Employment Type: Full Time Educational Qualification: BS/MS in Mechanical or Optical Engineering or Quality Engineering; plus strong industry experience
  
  
Work Experience: Minimum 4 years of space quality experience, including a strong “hands-on”
  
  
background with optical or optomechanical assemblies
  
  
**Role Description**
Camera Calibration Engineer responsible for developing and implementing algorithms to accurately calibrate camera systems for optimal image quality and geometric precision.
  
  
**Responsibilities & Duties**

* Develop new testers/critical optical components to meet design requirements for calibration and test.
* Participate in Pre flight calibration including geometrical, spatial and radiometric calibration, aberration characterisation, stray light test etc.
* Develop and lead alignment and integration of the payload to the bus
* Develop and deploy software that calibrates and tests imaging systems.
* Assist in Commissioning and in flight calibration
* Analyse volume data to provide mentorship on engineering decisions.
* Assist QA in formulating milestone based checks and verification procedures for

the payload.
  
  
**Desirable Skills & Certifications**

* Experience with working in an optical laboratory and familiarity with optical metrology tools an advantage
* Deep understanding of imaging systems & camera technology.
* Mechanical/HW/SW problem solving and optimisation skill.
* Experience in lens characterisation methodology and calibration.
* Experience in image processing or software development, programming experience with C++ / Matlab / Python preferred.
* Exposure/knowledge about thermal properties, space-qualified materials and adhesives.
* Test plan, procedure, and report preparation for different environmental tests performed on spacecraft
* Well conversant with quality standards defined by different space agencies and organisations
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Must be able to read and interpret data, information, and documents

**Candidate Acumen**
Demonstrates strong analytical and mathematical acumen with deep understanding of camera models, calibration algorithms, and system-level integration for high-precision imaging.
  
  
**Benefits**
Health insurance coverage
  
  
Unlimited leaves & flexible working hours
  
  
Role-based remote work and work-from-home benefit
  
  
Relocation assistance
  
  
Professional Mental Wellness services
  
  
Creche facility for primary caregivers (limited to India)
  
  
Employee Stock Options for all hires
  
  
**About Pixxel**
Pixxel is a space data company and spacecraft manufacturer redefining Earth observation with hyperspectral imaging. The company’s first three commercial hyperspectral satellites—Fireflies—deliver imagery at 5-meter resolution and 135+ spectral bands, providing 50x richer detail than traditional Earth observation systems and unlocking insights across agriculture, climate, energy, environment, and more.
  
  
Once fully deployed, Pixxel’s constellation of 18-24 satellites will capture imagery across up to 250 bands in VNIR and SWIR ranges, with a 40 km swath and daily global revisit capability. Pixxel’s most unique strength is its full-stack approach, integrating every layer of the value chain from satellite hardware and manufacturing to AI-powered analytics.
  
  
Pixxel’s satellite constellation is complemented by Aurora, its in-house Earth Observation Studio that simplifies satellite imagery analysis and democratises remote sensing for all. Designed to make hyperspectral data more accessible, Aurora by Pixxel combines high-frequency imagery with AI-powered tools to generate actionable insights, even for users without technical backgrounds. The third pillar of Pixxel’s ecosystem is its in-house satellite manufacturing capability. Beyond building its own spacecraft, Pixxel also provides satellite systems and subsystems to other organisations. This dual capacity sets it apart in a sector where most companies focus on either payload design or data operations, but not both.
  
  
Pixxel’s team is young but deeply mission-aligned, with a culture rooted in curiosity, speed, and long-term thinking. As the company grows its constellation and expands Aurora, the focus remains on making space-based insights practical, scalable, and genuinely helpful so that the health of the planet becomes measurable and action becomes possible.
  
  
Pixxel was the only Indian startup selected for the Techstars Starburst Space Accelerator in Los Angeles and has been recognised in TIME’s Best Inventions of 2023, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Via Satellite’s Top Innovators list.
  
  
For more information, see our Careers page or follow Pixxel on LinkedIn and X/Twitter.
  
  
Culture
  
  
Pixxel is an organization where we enable our employees to work on world-changing problems that they are passionate about, and a place where they can be their best selves day in and day out while ensuring they have fun every day.
  
  
Central to our employee-first ethos is a commitment to ensuring that every team member feels valued and heard. We nurture a healthy and supportive work environment where we prioritise well-being and growth in all aspects of life

title: Founder's Office
description:

ENEG Mobility is building an electric car for Shared Mobility. Engineered for cost efficiency, reliability & to fuel the mass adoption of EVs.

The company is currently in its earliest stage, working on government partnerships, OEM/fleet conversations, supplier ecosystem building, factory planning, and strategic fundraising.

title: Senior Engineer - Testing & Certification
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O&M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Wind Turbine Generator (WTG)**
**:**
Adani Wind Turbine Generators (WTG) is a leading player in the renewable energy sector, specializing in the design, manufacturing, and installation of high-performance wind turbine systems. With a commitment to sustainability, Adani WTGs deliver efficient and reliable energy solutions, contributing to clean power generation across global markets.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Performance Management Engineer is responsible for analyzing wind turbine operational data to identify areas for performance improvement. This role uses advanced data analytics tools to assess turbine efficiency, power output, and reliability, conducting root cause analysis on performance deviations and implementing corrective actions. The Engineer participates in testing and validation of performance enhancements, such as control system updates and aerodynamic optimizations, and manages SCADA systems to ensure accurate data collection and monitoring. This role also involves supporting predictive maintenance initiatives by analyzing condition-based data and implementing maintenance strategies that reduce downtime. The Performance Management Engineer collaborates with cross-functional teams to align performance enhancement activities with overall product development goals and contributes to continuous improvement by proposing new methodologies and tools to optimize turbine performance.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Data Analysis and Performance Monitoring**

* Analyze operational data from wind turbines to assess performance against expected benchmarks, including power output, efficiency, and availability.
* Use advanced data analytics software (e.g., MATLAB, Python, R) to identify trends, anomalies, and areas for improvement in turbine performance.

**Performance Optimization and Troubleshooting**

* Conduct performance optimization studies, focusing on areas such as blade aerodynamics, control system tuning, and power curve adjustments.
* Assist in troubleshooting performance issues on-site, using diagnostic tools to perform root cause analysis and implement corrective measures.

**Testing and Validation of Performance Improvements**

* Participate in the testing and validation of performance enhancement initiatives, including prototype testing and field trials.
* Collect and analyze test data to validate improvements, providing feedback to engineering teams for further refinement.

**SCADA and Data Acquisition System Management**

* Manage SCADA systems and other data acquisition tools, ensuring accurate and reliable data collection for performance analysis.
* Set up alarms, thresholds, and monitoring parameters to track key performance indicators in real-time.

**Predictive Maintenance and Condition Monitoring**

* Implement predictive maintenance strategies using data analytics to forecast potential failures and schedule proactive maintenance.
* Monitor condition-based data, such as vibration and temperature readings, to detect early signs of component wear and prevent performance drops.

**Documentation and Reporting**

* Maintain detailed records of performance analysis, tests conducted, and optimization measures implemented.
* Prepare performance reports, highlighting key findings, improvement opportunities, and corrective actions taken.

**Compliance with Standards and Procedures**

* Ensure all performance management activities comply with relevant industry standards and internal procedures, maintaining high data integrity and accuracy.
* Support the preparation of compliance documentation for certification and audits.

**Collaboration with Cross-Functional Teams**

* Work closely with product improvement, R&D, and operations teams to align performance enhancement activities with overall product development goals.
* Provide technical support and performance insights during the design and testing phases of new turbine components.

**Training and Continuous Learning**

* Engage in continuous learning and professional development to stay updated on the latest performance optimization techniques and tools.
* Participate in internal training programs and knowledge-sharing sessions to enhance skills and contribute to team development.

**Adherence to Ethical Standards**

* Adhere to organizational ethical standards in data handling, analysis, and reporting, ensuring transparency and objectivity in performance assessments.
* Participate in training on corporate policies, ethics, and compliance to uphold high professional standards.

**Key Stakeholders - Internal**

* Lead - Performance Management
* QA Teams
* Manufacturing Teams

**Key Stakeholders - External**

* Performance Monitoring Equipment Vendors
* Data Analytics Consultants

**Qualifications**
**Educational Background:**

* BE in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering.

**Work Experience**

* 5+ years in performance analysis and optimization, focusing on operational data, efficiency improvements, and maintenance strategy development.

**Industry Knowledge**

* Proficient in data analytics, SCADA data interpretation, and applying continuous improvement methodologies to enhance turbine performance.

title: Director - SLED Proposals & Pursuit Excellence
description:
**What Are We Looking For**
We are not looking for someone whose idea of proposal leadership is reviewing documents after everyone else has finished writing them. We are looking for a builder, problem solver and owner. The right person will see an ambiguous RFP, a fragmented team and an aggressive deadline and instinctively create structure around it. They will ask the difficult questions early, push teams to make decisions, challenge weak assumptions, refuse to submit mediocre work and take personal ownership of the quality of every major pursuit. This person should be comfortable recommending a No-Bid when the facts do not support pursuit, and equally comfortable mobilizing a cross-functional team when Dash decides to compete.
  
  
Pursuit Leadership & Win Strategy
  
  

* Own the proposal lifecycle from qualified opportunity through final submission, clarification, oral presentation and post-award handoff.
* Lead structured Bid/No-Bid decisions based on strategic fit, contract access, customer knowledge, incumbent position, competition, past performance, technical capability, delivery feasibility, economics and probability of win.
* Establish win themes, differentiators, competitive positioning and evaluator-focused response strategies.
* Challenge teams when the solution, evidence or value proposition is not strong enough to win.
* Participate in strategic capture planning for high-value pursuits before RFP release.

Proposal Governance
  
  

* Establish and enforce a repeatable Dash proposal methodology covering kickoff, compliance matrix, proposal outline, writing assignments, solution reviews, executive reviews, production and submission.
* Run a daily or near-daily pursuit war room covering pipeline, active capture, proposal status, risks, dependencies and next actions.
* Ensure every submission is compliant, responsive, persuasive and delivered on time.
* Establish clear ownership and escalation paths so issues are identified early rather than discovered near the deadline.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead the Capture, Proposal Development and Technical Bid/Solution functions in India.
* Coach proposal writers and capture professionals to become stronger strategic contributors rather than task executors.
* Set quality standards and provide direct editorial and strategic feedback.
* Build a culture where people take ownership, communicate risks early and solve problems rather than simply escalating them.

Content & Knowledge Management
  
  

* Develop and govern Dash's reusable public-sector proposal content library.
* Maintain high-quality reusable content for corporate qualifications, technical capabilities, management approaches, transition, staffing, past performance, resumes, security, quality, cloud, data, AI and application modernization.
* Create templates, checklists, review criteria and pursuit playbooks; retire outdated or weak content.

Cross-Functional Leadership
  
  

* Work closely with U.S. business development, account leaders, solution architects, delivery leaders, finance, legal/compliance, recruiting and executive leadership.
* Convert SME input into a cohesive customer-facing story and hold owners accountable for timely inputs.
* Support oral presentations, demonstrations, clarification responses and negotiations when required.

Continuous Improvement & Metrics
  
  

* Track opportunities reviewed, go decisions, submissions, compliance defects, shortlist/interview rate, awards, win rate, cycle time and reasons for loss.
* Conduct structured win/loss reviews and convert lessons learned into process improvements.
* Identify responsible uses of AI and proposal technology to improve research, content reuse, compliance checking and productivity without compromising confidentiality or accuracy.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* 12+ years of experience in proposals, bids, capture, presales or government contracting.
* Significant direct experience supporting U.S. government opportunities; strong SLED experience is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex IT services or professional-services proposals.
* Strong understanding of RFP/RFQ/RFI requirements, compliance matrices, evaluation criteria and public-sector procurement processes.
* Exceptional written and spoken business English and strong executive-level editing skills.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams under aggressive deadlines and challenging senior stakeholders constructively.
* Experience developing proposal processes, templates, content libraries and quality standards.

**Preferred Qualifications / Experience**

* APMP certification or meaningful Shipley-style proposal/capture experience.
* Experience with IT services, application development, cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, staffing or digital transformation.
* Experience with U.S. state contract vehicles, cooperative contracts, MSP/VMS programs or large government IDIQ-style vehicles.
* Experience managing an India-based proposal/capture team supporting U.S. operations.

The Personality We Are Looking For
  
  

* Takes ownership even when the problem technically belongs to someone else.
* Hates surprises and surfaces issues before they become emergencies.
* Is comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.
* Can be demanding without becoming difficult to work with.
* Cares deeply about winning but is disciplined enough to recommend a No-Bid.
* Asks how the team can make the process better after both wins and losses.
* Does not need constant supervision or detailed instructions.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
Within the first six months, this leader should have established a predictable capture-to-submission operating model, clear pursuit gates, reusable proposal assets, consistent review practices and measurable visibility into why Dash is winning or losing government pursuits.

description:
**Job Title:**
Powertrain Simulation and Modeling Engineer - Aircraft Electronics & Software Development

**Department:**

Research & Development (R&D)

**Industry:**
Aerospace, Aircraft Electronics & Avionics

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Experience Requirements: 2 years**
or more of experienced candidates.

Candidates may be considered at different experience levels based on their technical capabilities:

* Strong fundamentals in MATLAB, Simulink, Python, control systems, and electrical/electronic engineering.
* Practical experience in aircraft electronics, powertrain modeling, electric propulsion, embedded systems, simulation automation, or aerospace system validation.

**Educational Qualifications:**

Bachelor's or master's degree in one of the following disciplines:

Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Instrumentation and Control Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Embedded Systems or a related engineering discipline.

Candidates with relevant professional experience in MATLAB/ Simulink, aircraft electronics, electric propulsion, powertrain simulation, or Python-based engineering tools are encouraged to apply.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a skilled MATLAB/Simulink engineer with expertise in aircraft electronics, powertrain system simulation, and Python programming to support the development, modeling, simulation, analysis, and validation of aircraft systems.

The candidate will be responsible for developing MATLAB/Simulink-based simulation models for aircraft powertrain systems, electrical power distribution, propulsion systems, control algorithms, and avionics applications. The role also involves Python-based automation, engineering data analysis, software testing, and integration of electronic and embedded control systems.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of system modeling, aircraft electrical and electronic systems, powertrain performance analysis, and programming, with the ability to work across hardware, software, and system engineering teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. MATLAB/Simulink Development**

* Develop and maintain simulation models using MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow.
* Implement mathematical models, control algorithms, and system-level simulations for aircraft applications.
* Perform dynamic system analysis, numerical simulations, and performance evaluations.
* Develop MATLAB scripts for engineering calculations, data processing, visualization, and simulation automation.
* Debug simulation models and validate results against design requirements and test data.
* Support model-based design and simulation-driven development activities.

**B. Aircraft Powertrain Simulation and Modeling**

* Develop MATLAB/Simulink-based simulation tools for aircraft powertrain systems.
* Model aircraft propulsion and powertrain architectures, including conventional, electric, and hybrid-electric systems, as applicable.
* Develop and analyze models of electric motors, generators, batteries, inverters, power converters, motor controllers, and associated electrical systems.
* Perform aircraft power demand, load estimation, energy consumption, efficiency, and endurance analysis.
* Simulate powertrain operating conditions, transient responses, load variations, and system performance.
* Develop battery models and implement State of Charge (SOC) estimation and energy management algorithms, where applicable.
* Analyze electrical power generation, distribution, conversion, and consumption within aircraft systems.
* Integrate powertrain models with sensors, control units, avionics interfaces, and embedded controllers.
* Conduct simulation-based verification and validate powertrain performance against theoretical calculations, system specifications, and available test data.
* Support the development of reusable MATLAB-based aircraft powertrain simulation tools and engineering workflows.

**C. Aircraft Electronics and Avionics**

* Support the modeling, development, and testing of aircraft electronic systems and avionics subsystems.
* Analyze sensor interfaces, data acquisition systems, instrumentation, and electronic control units.
* Develop algorithms for signal processing, sensor data analysis, monitoring, and fault detection.
* Support integration between electronic hardware, embedded software, and simulation environments.
* Analyze system performance and troubleshoot electrical, electronic, and control-related issues.
* Assist in the development of automated test procedures for aircraft electronic systems.

**D. Python Programming and Automation**

* Develop Python scripts and utilities for simulation automation, engineering calculations, and data analysis.
* Automate MATLAB/Simulink model execution, parameter sweeps, test cases, and report generation.
* Process and visualize simulation outputs, test logs, sensor measurements, and powertrain performance data.
* Develop tools for comparing simulation results with experimental or hardware test data.
* Implement data processing, plotting, statistical analysis, and performance evaluation workflows.
* Integrate Python-based tools with MATLAB/Simulink workflows using suitable interfaces.

**E. Embedded Systems and Communication Interfaces**

* Support the development and testing of embedded control systems used in aircraft electronics and powertrain applications.
* Work with microcontrollers, electronic control units, sensors, and actuator interfaces.
* Develop or integrate control algorithms intended for embedded implementation.
* Understand and work with communication protocols such as UART, SPI, I²C, CAN, and ARINC 429, as applicable.
* Assist with hardware-software integration, data logging, debugging, and interface testing.
* Collaborate with firmware and hardware engineers to resolve system integration issues.

**F. Testing, Verification, and Validation**

* Perform Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) and Model-in-the-Loop (MIL) testing.
* Support Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing, where applicable.
* Develop test scenarios, test scripts, verification procedures, and validation reports.
* Analyze simulation and test results to identify performance deviations and potential design issues.
* Maintain technical documentation, model specifications, test records, and engineering reports.
* Follow applicable aerospace software, system safety, quality, and configuration management processes.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong programming knowledge in MATLAB and Python.
* Practical knowledge of MATLAB/Simulink for system modeling, simulation, and algorithm development.
* Understanding of aircraft electronics, avionics, electrical systems, or aerospace engineering fundamentals.
* Knowledge of dynamic system modeling, control systems, and numerical analysis.
* Understanding of aircraft powertrain concepts, electrical power systems, or propulsion system fundamentals.
* Ability to develop scripts for engineering calculations, data processing, and simulation result analysis.
* Familiarity with debugging, software testing, verification, and technical documentation.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Technical Skills**

* Experience with MATLAB/Simulink, Stateflow, Simscape, and Simscape Electrical.
* Familiarity with Aerospace Toolbox and other relevant MATLAB toolboxes.
* Knowledge of aircraft powertrain simulation, electric propulsion, or hybrid-electric propulsion systems.
* Experience in modeling batteries, electric motors, generators, inverters, converters, and electrical loads.
* Understanding of battery State of Charge (SOC), energy management, power demand, and efficiency calculations.
* Knowledge of control system design, signal processing, sensor modeling, and fault detection.
* Familiarity with embedded C/C++, microcontrollers, and hardware-software integration.
* Experience with SIL/HIL testing, automated test frameworks, and model-based design.
* Familiarity with Git, version control, and software configuration management.
* Knowledge of aerospace development standards, including DO-178C where applicable to the project.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical and mathematical modeling skills.
* Practical problem-solving and debugging capabilities.
* Ability to translate engineering requirements into simulation models and software tools.
* Good understanding of electrical and electronic systems.
* Ability to analyze complex simulation outputs and prepare technical reports.
* Attention to detail, quality, reliability, and safety.
* Effective communication and collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Willingness to learn new aerospace technologies and simulation methodologies.

title: BIM Coordinator
description:
**Job Description: Building Information Modeling (BIM)**
**Position:**
BIM Coordinator
  
  
**Experience:**
10 to 20+ Years
  
  
**Location:**
Ahmedabad
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Position Overview**
The
**BIM Coordinator**
is responsible for establishing, governing, and driving Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Virtual Design & Construction (VDC) workflows across preconstruction and field operations.
**This position operates under a management and coordination framework rather than an in-house modeling/production drafting model.**
All design models and trade-specific fabrication models (LOD 350/400) are authored by external design consultants and specialized trade subcontractors (MEPF, structural steel, concrete, drywall/framing, and building envelope). The BIM Coordinator serves as the GC's central technical authority who orchestrates model federation, establishes project BIM standards, audits incoming data, facilitates multi-trade clash resolution, and bridges model data into field execution, 4D logistics, and reality capture.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* BIM Execution Planning (BEP) & Governance
* Author, implement, and enforce project-specific BIM Execution Plans (BEP/BXP) aligned with owner agreements, prime contract deliverables, and industry benchmarks (ISO 19650, AIA G202).
* Define modeling scopes of work, coordinate origins, project grid benchmarks, Level of Development (LOD 300 to LOD 400/500) requirements, and geometric tolerances for all subcontractor agreements.
* Establish and govern the project Common Data Environment (CDE) using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360, Procore, or Revizto, setting upload schedules, permission tiers, and automated folder distribution workflows.
* Multi-Trade Coordination & Subcontractor Oversight
* Lead weekly spatial coordination meetings with MEPF, structural, framing, and specialty trade subcontractors to drive constructability resolution before fabrication and installation.
* Manage and federate trade models; run automated and manual clash analyses using Navisworks Manage and Revizto, distinguishing real physical/clearance conflicts from false positives.
* Hold trade contractors accountable to coordination milestones, clash resolution sign-offs, and agreed-upon space allocations according to contract documents.
* Manage issue-tracking platforms (e.g., Revizto, ACC Issues, BIM Track), issuing action items, constructability RFIs, and tracking items to verified closeout.
* Subcontractor Model Auditing & Quality Assurance (QA/QC)
* Audit incoming trade models to verify compliance with BEP guidelines, coordinate systems, parameter schemas, naming standards, and equipment clearance requirements.
* Review subcontractor shop drawings, fabrication spool sheets, and sleeve/penetration layouts directly against the federated model for sign-off prior to field installation.
* Ensure all models incorporate manufacturer-approved cut sheets, maintenance access envelopes, and code-required clearances.
* 4D Logistics, 5D Preconstruction & Constructability Analysis
* Leverage design and trade models during preconstruction to extract quantities for estimating and constructability reviews via Assemble Systems, Navisworks, or CostX.
* Partner with Project Schedulers and Superintendents to assemble 4D construction simulations (e.g., Synchro 4D or Navisworks TimeLiner) linked to CPM schedules (Primavera P6 / MS Project) for site logistics, crane staging, and trade sequencing.
* Support project teams in developing site logistics visualizations, temporary works layouts, and sequencing presentations for owner and stakeholder meetings.
* Reality Capture & Field Layout Integration
* Manage jobsite laser scanning (LiDAR / SLAM) operations (via self-perform scanning or specialty scanning vendors) and integrate registered point clouds into active federated models.
* Perform scan-to-BIM comparison and deviation analysis (floor flatness/levelness, concrete anchor placement, MEP penetration verification) to catch discrepancies prior to concrete pours and interior buildouts.
* Prepare and export coordinated layout point data to field layout teams utilizing Robotic Total Stations (RTS) (e.g., Trimble Field Link, Leica iCON).
* Equip and train field superintendents, foremen, and project engineers to access federated models on tablets for real-time site verification.
* Handover, Closeout & Process Automation
* Manage the collection, validation, and assembly of final coordinated As-Built models, COBie data, and asset handover deliverables required for owner facility management.

description:

**Infinnium**
!

We are hiring for the position of
**SaaS Content Writer**
to join our growing US-based IT company in Ahmedabad.

**Designation:**
**SaaS Content Writer**

**Openings: 2**

**About Company:**

Infinnium Infotech is redefining the way organizations engage with data to gain actionable intelligence. We develop software solutions for corporations, law firms, and government agencies using modern technologies such as AI and machine learning to support information governance, including compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, and other privacy regulations, litigation readiness, and electronic discovery.Our software product brings simplicity to the complex world of digital data, combining the strength of people and modern technology to help organizations effectively address today’s complex information governance needs and realize the intrinsic value of their data.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a Technical Writer / Product Documentation Specialist to join our team and help create and maintain clear, accurate, and user-friendly product documentation.

The role involves working closely with Product, Development, QA, and Support teams to understand product functionality, UI changes, new features, enhancements, and workflows, and convert this information into comprehensive help documentation.

This role will be particularly important as we undergo a major UI transformation of the product, requiring significant documentation updates and new content within defined timelines. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with technical information, reviewing development stories, understanding application workflows, coordinating with technical teams, and using AI powered tools to improve documentation quality and efficiency.

**Role Summary :**

This position is ideal for a technically inclined writer who enjoys learning software products, collaborating with engineering and QA teams, and turning complex product functionality into clear, practical user documentation. Candidates who combine strong English communication skills with technical curiosity, attention to detail, and effective use of AI-assisted tools are encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Review TFS/Azure DevOps stories, requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical details to understand new features and product changes.
* Analyze existing and newly developed product functionality and understand end-to-end user workflows.
* Work closely with developers, QA/testers, product teams, and support teams to clarify functionality and documentation requirements.
* Participate in discussions, demonstrations, and walkthroughs with developers and testers to understand how features work in the actual product.
* Create and update product help files, user guides, feature documentation, configuration guides, and workflow documentation.
* Document new features and UI changes with clear, structured, and easy-to-understand explanations.
* Review the application UI and ensure documentation accurately reflects the latest screens, fields, buttons, options, workflows, and terminology.
* Identify gaps or inconsistencies between product functionality and existing documentation and coordinate with relevant teams for clarification.
* Document configuration options, prerequisites, permissions, limitations, dependencies, and expected behavior where applicable.
* Update existing documentation whenever product functionality, workflows, or UI elements change.
* Maintain consistency in terminology, formatting, structure, screenshots, and documentation standards across the product.
* Coordinate documentation updates with product releases and ensure documentation is completed within required timelines.
* Upload and publish completed documentation to the product/help system as required.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Excellent technical writing and documentation skills.
* Ability to understand software functionality and explain it in simple, user-friendly language.
* Experience working with software products, SaaS applications, or technical platforms.
* Ability to read and understand user stories, requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical discussions.
* Ability to work effectively with developers and QA/testers to understand functionality and validate documentation.
* Good understanding of software development and testing processes.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when documenting UI elements, workflows, configurations, and system behavior.
* Familiarity with TFS/Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar work-management tools.
* Experience with documentation/help-authoring tools or knowledge bases.
* Experience with screenshots, screen annotation, flow diagrams, and other visual documentation.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and similar productivity tools.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or equivalent tools.

**Apply Here:**

https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/1hGjZ99xUj

**Thanks & Regards,**

**Yamini Patel**

**Infinnium**

**HR Manager**

title: Market Analysis And Packaging Development Intern
description:
**Company Description**
Deep Agro Food is the parent company of Deep Veda, a premium healthy snacking brand focused on nutritious Makhana (Fox Nuts). The company directly sources from aquatic farms in Saharsa, Bihar and operates from Gujarat, ensuring farm-to-table quality and traceability. Its products are 100% natural, vegan, gluten-free, and high in protein, offered in a variety of roasted flavors such as Plain Roasted, Pudina, Peri Peri, Cream & Onion, and Himalayan Salt & Pepper. Deep Agro Food serves retail, wholesale, bulk packaging, and festive/corporate gifting segments across India, and is actively expanding its footprint with distributors, retailers, and corporate partners.

**Role Description**
The Market Analysis and Packaging Development Intern will support market research and competitive analysis for the healthy snacking and Makhana category, focusing on consumer trends, pricing, and positioning in the Greater Ahmedabad Area and broader markets. This internship role is on-site in the Greater Ahmedabad Area and involves assisting in the design and evaluation of packaging concepts, including formats, materials, and branding elements aligned with Deep Veda’s identity. The intern will help prepare reports, presentations, and data summaries for internal stakeholders, and collaborate with marketing, sales, and operations teams to refine packaging for retail, bulk, and gifting segments. Daily activities may include data collection from online marketplaces, retail visits, feedback gathering from customers and partners, and coordination with vendors and designers.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess foundational skills in market research and data analysis, including the ability to collect, organize, and interpret consumer and competitor information.
* Candidates should possess skills related to packaging development and product branding, such as basic design sensibilities, understanding of packaging formats, and interest in visual identity and labeling.
* Candidates should possess skills in communication and collaboration, including clear written and verbal communication, presentation of findings, and effective teamwork with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess organizational and planning skills, including attention to detail, time management, and the ability to manage multiple tasks in a dynamic on-site environment.
* Enrollment in or recent completion of a degree in Marketing, Business, Food Technology, Packaging Technology, Design, or a related field is beneficial, as is prior internship or project experience in FMCG, food brands, or packaging.
* Basic proficiency with productivity tools (e.g., spreadsheets, presentation software) and an interest in healthy snacking, sustainability, and consumer-focused product development are advantageous.

title: Head of Electrical Engineering
description:
**\*Purpose/Objective:**

Lead the Electrical Engineering function for Adani WTG Manufacturing with end-to-end technical ownership of electrical systems across the WTG platform. The role will drive electrical architecture, component engineering, system integration, verification & validation, grid compliance, certification, reliability improvement, localization and technology development. The incumbent will work closely with Mechanical, Loads, Controls, SCADA, Blade, Nacelle, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Sourcing, Project Engineering and Service teams to deliver reliable, cost-competitive and certifiable WTG platforms.

**About Business:**

**Adani Group:**
Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O&M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

**Wind Turbine Generator (WTG):**
Adani Wind Turbine Generators (WTG) is a leading player in the renewable energy sector, specializing in the design, manufacturing, and installation of high-performance wind turbine systems. With a commitment to sustainability, Adani WTGs deliver efficient and reliable energy solutions, contributing to clean power generation across global markets.

**Job Purpose:**

The Lead Grid Compliance leads the development and implementation of strategies to ensure wind turbines meet regulatory requirements for grid connection, power quality, and dynamic grid support. This role oversees the design and integration of SCADA systems, focusing on real-time monitoring, control, and data acquisition to optimize turbine performance. The Lead manages testing and validation processes, including power quality assessments and grid support simulations, and prepares compliance reports for regulatory bodies. This position also addresses cybersecurity risks within SCADA systems, drives continuous improvement in grid interaction technologies, and mentors a team of engineers to enhance their expertise in grid compliance and SCADA operations.

**\***
Key Responsibilities of Role

1. WTG Electrical System Architecture

* Own the overall electrical architecture of wind turbine platforms from concept through serial production.
* Define system/sub-system requirements, technical specifications, interfaces and design criteria.
* Lead engineering of:
* Generator and generator interfaces
* Power converters
* Main and auxiliary transformers
* Pitch electrical system
* Low-voltage and medium-voltage systems
* Switchgear and protection systems
* UPS and auxiliary power systems
* Cable and harness systems
* Earthing and lightning protection interfaces
* Electrical panels and power distribution systems
* Ensure robust electrical interfaces across converter, generator, controls, transformer, switchgear and grid connection systems.

2. Generator & Power Conversion

* Provide technical leadership for generator selection, specification, integration and validation.
* Lead converter architecture, sizing and performance requirements, including thermal and electrical interfaces.
* Drive system-level optimization between generator, converter, transformer and turbine control.
* Review component design margins, losses, efficiency, temperature rise and operating envelopes.

3. Grid Integration & Compliance

* Lead WTG electrical engineering support for grid-code compliance and turbine-grid integration.
* Guide power quality, reactive power, voltage/frequency response and protection philosophy.
* Coordinate engineering inputs for electrical modelling, grid studies and compliance verification.
* Ensure electrical design supports applicable project and market-specific grid requirements.

4. Controls, SCADA & Electrical Interfaces

* Work closely with Controls and SCADA engineering teams to ensure complete integration of electrical equipment into the turbine control architecture.
* Define sensors, measurements, alarms, protections, interlocks and operational sequences.
* Lead interface management among electrical hardware, turbine controller, converter controller and SCADA.
* Support troubleshooting of turbine-level electrical and control interactions.

5. Design Verification & Validation

* Establish electrical DVP&R / verification and validation plans for components and turbine systems.
* Lead design reviews, technical risk assessments and engineering sign-offs.
* Define prototype, laboratory, bench and turbine-level validation requirements.
* Lead root-cause analysis for electrical failures using structured methodologies such as
  **8D, FMEA/FMECA, Fault Tree Analysis and RCA**
  .
* Drive corrective and preventive engineering actions based on field and test observations.

6. Reliability & Product Performance

* Own electrical reliability improvement across the WTG lifecycle.
* Analyse recurring failures involving converters, generators, transformers, pitch electrical systems and other electrical components.
* Drive improvements in thermal management, electrical protection, component life and system robustness.
* Develop design improvements based on testing, manufacturing and field-performance feedback.

7. Certification & Engineering Compliance

* Ensure electrical designs are compliant with applicable wind turbine certification and electrical engineering requirements.
* Coordinate engineering activities with certification bodies and external technical agencies where required.
* Maintain design documentation, calculations, specifications, compliance evidence and engineering change records.
* Support WTG type certification and platform upgrades from an electrical engineering perspective.

8. Localization & Supplier Engineering

* Drive localization and alternate-source development for critical electrical components.
* Develop technical specifications and qualification criteria for suppliers.
* Participate in supplier capability assessment, technical reviews and component qualification.
* Work with Supply Chain and Quality teams on technical closure of supplier deviations and engineering changes.
* Drive design-to-cost and value-engineering initiatives without compromising reliability or compliance.

9. Manufacturing & Service Support

* Provide engineering support for manufacturing ramp-up and serial production.
* Address electrical non-conformities and recurring manufacturing issues through permanent engineering solutions.
* Support commissioning and service teams on complex turbine electrical failures and field issues.
* Translate field lessons learned into product/design improvements.

10. Engineering Leadership

* Build and lead a strong Electrical Engineering organization covering core electrical systems and relevant specialist competencies.
* Establish engineering processes, design standards, review mechanisms and technical governance.
* Mentor engineers and develop technical competency in WTG electrical technology.
* Manage engineering priorities across new-product development, localization, cost reduction, field issues and platform improvements.
* Collaborate with cross-functional and international engineering partners on technology development.

**\***
Qualifications and Experience

* **Qualification:**
  B.E./B.Tech – Electrical / Electrical & Electronics Engineering; M.E./M.Tech preferred.
* **Experience:**
  **15–22 years**
  , preferably in WTG / Wind OEM engineering.
* Strong expertise in
  **WTG electrical systems, generators, converters, grid integration, controls/SCADA and validation**
  .
