title: Oracle Fusion Financial Consultant
description:
**About the Company**

Medovate Pvt Ltd is building a Technology and Operations Centre in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, to deliver Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials services for a multi-entity international group operating across the United States, United Kingdom, Mexico, China, and India. The group runs Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP across multiple legal entities and ledgers, with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) connecting Fusion Financials to banking partners, intercompany systems, and external platforms.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an Oracle Fusion Finance Functional Consultant to strengthen the Finance practice at Medovate's Ahmedabad center. This is a hands-on functional delivery role. You will support the configuration and delivery of Oracle Fusion Financials across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, Tax, and Fixed Assets, working under the direction of the Finance Functional Lead and alongside senior consultants. You will contribute to design workshops, execute configuration, prepare functional documentation, and support testing across a multi-entity international environment. This is an opportunity to broaden your Oracle Fusion Financials experience across multiple modules and geographies while building depth in a specialist Finance capability.

**Responsibilities**

**Solution Design and Configuration**

* Participate in discovery workshops and requirements-gathering sessions with Finance business stakeholders across multiple legal entities and geographies.
* Contribute to the functional design of Oracle Fusion Financials, including Chart of Accounts structure, ledger setup, SLA accounting rules, tax determination, and period-close processes.
* Prepare functional specifications, configuration workbooks, and gap-fit analyses under the guidance of the Finance Functional Lead.
* Perform configuration across GL, AP, AR, Cash Management, Tax, and Fixed Assets in line with agreed design decisions and Oracle best-practice standards.
* Support the setup of intercompany accounting, netting arrangements, and consolidation hierarchies for a multi-entity international group structure.

**General Ledger (GL)**

* Support Chart of Accounts configuration across multiple legal entities covering US, UK, Mexico, China, and India reporting requirements.
* Configure ledgers, accounting calendars, currencies, and intercompany balancing rules under direction.
* Assist with configuration and validation of Subledger Accounting (SLA) rules to ensure accurate accounting distributions from subledgers into the GL.
* Support period-end close activities including subledger close, revaluation, translation, and intercompany elimination runs.

**Accounts Payable (AP)**

* Configure AP functionality covering invoice management, three-way PO matching, payment processing, supplier setup, and BPM approval workflows.
* Configure and test multi-country electronic payment formats (SEPA, BACS, SWIFT, ACH, NEFT/RTGS) and payment process profiles aligned to each entity's banking arrangements.
* Support AP-to-GL accounting configuration including liability accounts, prepayments, withholding tax, and intercompany payables.

**Accounts Receivable (AR)**

* Configure AR functionality covering customer billing, AutoInvoice rule setup, multi-currency receipts, lockbox processing, and deductions management.
* Support the configuration of receipt application rules, aging bucket setups, and bad debt provisioning.
* Support AR-to-GL accounting distributions including revenue recognition and intercompany receivables setups.

**Cash Management**

* Support bank account structure setup and bank statement reconciliation configuration across group entities and banking relationships.
* Configure automated reconciliation rules, tolerance thresholds, and exception handling for multi-currency bank statement matching.
* Support testing of OIC-delivered bank interface integrations, including statement import formats, reconciliation mapping, and error handling.

**Tax, Oracle Tax**

* Configure Oracle Fusion Tax across applicable regimes including GST (India), VAT (UK), IVA (Mexico), US Sales Tax, and China VAT/Fapiao, under the direction of the Finance Functional Lead.
* Support the setup of tax determination rules, tax condition sets, and tax registration configurations, including scenarios such as intercompany transactions, imports and exports, reverse charge, and withholding tax.
* Support indirect tax compliance activities and help ensure Oracle tax outputs meet local statutory reporting requirements.

**Fixed Assets (FA)**

* Configure Fixed Assets functionality including corporate and tax asset books, depreciation methods, prorate conventions, and mass addition rules.
* Support CIP-to-asset capitalization workflows, asset retirement processes, and revaluation setups across operating jurisdictions.
* Support FA period-end close activities including depreciation runs and FA-to-GL reconciliation.

**Delivery and Collaboration**

* Work with Finance business users to clarify requirements and resolve day-to-day functional queries.
* Contribute to the Finance workstream across project phases: Discover, Design, Build, Test, and Deploy, ensuring assigned deliverables are completed on time and to quality.
* Prepare test scripts, execute SIT and UAT cycles, and log and track defects to closure.
* Collaborate with Oracle Fusion technical teams on RICEW deliverables, providing functional input on Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Extensions, and Workflows.
* Support OIC integration testing connecting Oracle Fusion Financials to banking, intercompany, and external systems.
* Continuously build product knowledge across Oracle Fusion Financials modules and work towards relevant Oracle certifications.

**Qualifications and Skills**

***Required***

* 3 or more years of hands-on Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials functional experience, including at least one full-cycle implementation or a major rollout, upgrade, or support engagement.
* Practical configuration experience across at least three of the core modules: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, Tax, and Fixed Assets.
* Working knowledge of core Financials concepts including Chart of Accounts structures, ledger and accounting calendar setup, and Subledger Accounting (SLA).
* Experience preparing functional documentation such as configuration workbooks, functional specifications, and test scripts.
* Experience executing SIT and UAT cycles, logging defects, and tracking them to closure.
* Understanding of the period-end close process across subledgers and GL.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work directly with Finance business users to clarify requirements.
* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field.

***Preferred***

* Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials certification in one or more modules.
* Exposure to multi-entity, multi-currency, or multi-ledger environments.
* Experience with Oracle Tax configuration for one or more of GST (India), VAT (UK), IVA (Mexico), US Sales Tax, or China VAT.
* Familiarity with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) delivered interfaces, particularly bank and intercompany integrations, from a functional testing perspective.
* Working knowledge of BPM approval workflow configuration.
* Exposure to RICEW deliverables and collaboration with technical teams.
* A professional accounting qualification (CA, CMA, ACCA, CPA, or part-qualified) is an advantage.

description:

Smart Vayu : near Real-Time Source Apportionment (nRTSA) of Air Quality, Ahmedabad

1 Nos.

Ahmedabad, Gujarat (candidates must be based in Ahmedabad or relocate to Ahmedabad)

**ABOUT THE PROJECT**

Smart Vayu is a mobile, near real-time air quality source apportionment initiative of CoE ATMAN, IIT Kanpur. Using a mobile monitoring platform across representative sites in Ahmedabad, the project identifies the sources behind the city’s air pollution and builds a data-driven model to support evidence-based clean air action ahead of the Commonwealth Games 2030.

**ABOUT THE GROUP**

Please visit https://iitk.ac.in/atman/ for details.

**MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS**

* Based in Ahmedabad
* Gujarati: speaking, reading and writing (mandatory)
* Working knowledge of Excel, basic QGIS and Graphic design advantage

**ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATION**

Graduate or postgraduate degree in environmental science/engineering, atmospheric science, climate studies, or a closely related field.

**QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE (any one of the following)**

* B.Tech + fresher or 1 year of relevant experience, OR
* Postgraduate + fresher or 1 year of relevant experience, OR
* Graduate + 3–4 years of relevant experience

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

1. Basic proficiency in the MS Productivity Suite, including MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
2. Working knowledge of Python or R for scientific and environmental data processing and analysis.
3. Basic working knowledge of ArcGIS or QGIS for spatial data processing and visualization.
4. Basic understanding of air quality monitoring, atmospheric/environmental data and scientific measurements.
5. Basic graphic design skills for preparing charts, maps, and project communication material.
6. Good analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with attention to detail.

Temporary / Contractual

1 year or till the end of the project (whichever is earlier), renewed annually based on performance.

INR 25900-2100-63700 per month, consolidated. Salary shall be commensurate with experience and skills.

1. Resume/CV

3. Contact information of 2 references

title: Strategic Initiatives Associate
description:
Strategic Initiatives Associate

SVECTOR | Ahmedabad, Gujarat (On-site) | Full-time | Monday to Saturday

Experience: 0–4 years. Exceptional fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.

Reports to: Founder-CEO

About SVECTOR

SVECTOR is a technology company building intelligence infrastructure for enterprises and institutions. We develop software systems that help organizations understand complex information, improve decision-making and execute critical business processes. Our initiatives span enterprise intelligence, talent and leadership decision systems, healthcare, industrial technology, financial intelligence and defensive intelligence.

We work on problems where technology must do more than generate information. It must help people understand what is happening, decide what to do and turn decisions into measurable outcomes.

About the Role

We are hiring a Strategic Initiatives Associate to work closely with company leadership on selected product, technology and business initiatives. This is an early-career role for someone curious, capable and dependable who wants to understand how a technology business runs while taking direct responsibility for meaningful work.

You will take assigned objectives, work out a practical approach, bring the right people together and carry the work through to a verified result. You will work across engineering, product and business teams on things like investigating a product issue, understanding a customer requirement, preparing a business analysis, coordinating a pilot or moving an initiative from planning into execution.

This is not a role defined by attending meetings, preparing presentations or passing instructions between departments. The goal is to contribute directly to work that produces results. Experience in an identical role is not required.

What You Will Do

Project execution

• Understand the objective, constraints and importance of each assigned initiative.

• Break objectives into activities, deliverables, owners and milestones.

• Coordinate with engineering, product and business stakeholders.

• Spot delays, dependencies and gaps early, and resolve blockers within your authority.

• Follow up on commitments and keep progress, pending actions and open issues visible.

• Check completed work against its original requirements.

• Prepare short progress summaries and flag decisions that need leadership attention.

You are expected to understand the work you coordinate. Collecting updates or maintaining a tracker without understanding the problem is not enough.

Product and technical-business work

• Use SVECTOR's software products to understand their real capabilities and limits.

• Understand customer workflows and the problems customers expect the product to solve.

• Investigate reported issues and tell defects apart from unclear requirements and new feature requests.

• Turn business and customer needs into clear problem statements, requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.

• Work with engineers to understand constraints, dependencies and possible approaches.

• Support demos, testing, customer pilots and implementation, and confirm delivered work meets the requirement.

You are not being hired as a full-time software developer, but strong technical literacy matters. You should be comfortable with concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations and data flows, and willing to learn what you do not yet know.

Research and analysis

• Research companies, industries, technologies and business opportunities.

• Compare competitors, products, technical approaches and tools.

• Study enterprise customers and the environments they operate in.

• Review reports, specifications and original source material.

• Prepare decision briefs and recommendations that state what is known, what the evidence is, what remains uncertain and what to do next.

We expect you to go beyond the first search result, verify important claims, check numbers and explain your reasoning. We value independent thinking over long documents full of generic observations.

Business and customer initiatives

• Research prospective customers and decision-makers, and prepare background for key discussions.

• Support demos, discovery calls and technical-business presentations.

• Turn customer feedback into specific product or business actions.

• Help with proposals and solution briefs, and coordinate pilot follow-ups.

• Join customer meetings and speak with external stakeholders when authorized.

There is no individual sales quota. Pricing, contracts and financial commitments stay subject to leadership approval.

Leadership support and AI tools

• Prepare briefing notes and short memos for important discussions.

• Record decisions, commitments and open questions, and keep actions tied to owners.

• Use AI tools and modern software for research, document analysis and repetitive workflows, and check their output against reliable sources.

Using AI does not remove your responsibility to understand your own work. An unverified AI-generated document that you cannot explain is not an acceptable deliverable. You will also follow company rules on confidential information and data handling.

Who You Are

• Curious: you want to understand a hard problem, not avoid it.

• Accountable: a task is done when there is an outcome, not when you have sent a message. You are honest about obstacles and mistakes.

• Structured: you break problems down, test assumptions and reach reasoned conclusions, even under uncertainty.

• Clear communicator: excellent written and spoken English, with precise emails, briefs and summaries.

• Technically curious: you enjoy learning how software is built and used. Coding experience helps but is not required.

• Reliable: you respect deadlines and confidentiality, know when you need approval, and accept feedback well.

Qualifications

• 0–4 years of relevant experience. Internships, independent projects, research, entrepreneurship or full-time work all count.

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, AI, Data Science, Business Analytics, Economics, Management or a related field is preferred. Other backgrounds are considered where projects show the capability. No MBA required.

• Experience in product operations, business analysis, technical consulting, software development, strategic research or project execution is relevant.

We care about work you have actually completed: a product or technical project, an internship where you solved a real problem, a research assignment with a defensible conclusion, or an initiative where you took responsibility beyond your assigned work. Tell us your own contribution, the decisions you made and the results.

This role is not an administrative or personal-assistant job, a software engineering job focused on production code, a pure consulting role or a senior management position. It is an execution-oriented role centered on product understanding, research, problem-solving and completing assigned initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

• First 30 days: learn the products, workflows and priorities, and complete initial research and product assignments accurately.

• Days 31–60: own a defined initiative, prepare an execution approach and keep progress visible.

• Days 61–90: carry an initiative to an agreed result or a documented handover.

Hiring Process

1. Application review

2. Initial discussion

3. Practical assessment: a realistic research, product or business task. AI tools may be used where permitted, but you must be able to explain and verify your work.

4. Leadership interview

5. Offer discussion: responsibilities, compensation, schedule and joining date are confirmed before a written offer.

Working Arrangements

Full-time, on-site in Ahmedabad, Monday to Saturday. Schedule, compensation and joining terms are confirmed before a formal offer. If anything about the role or location does not match your expectations, please raise it in the first discussion.

How to Apply

Send your resume with a short note covering:

1. Your strongest example of ownership: what you did, which decisions you made and what happened.

2. Why you are interested in technology, research, product understanding and business execution.

3. Your current location, availability to work full-time on-site in Ahmedabad and earliest joining date.

Links to projects, GitHub, portfolios or research are welcome. Please skip the generic statements.

title: Technical Customer Support
description:

**Technical Support Engineer**
is responsible for providing advanced technical support for a SaaS platform by diagnosing and resolving complex customer issues related to APIs, integrations, authentication, custom configurations, and application functionality. The role involves troubleshooting using tools such as Postman, supporting API and OAuth integrations (including DocuSign), investigating Groovy scripts and workflow issues, analyzing logs, reproducing defects, and collaborating with Engineering, Product, and Professional Services teams to deliver timely resolutions while ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Investigate and resolve complex technical issues within the SaaS application.
* Troubleshoot REST APIs using Postman and interpret JSON/XML responses.
* Support API authentication methods including OAuth 2.0, API keys, and bearer tokens.
* Diagnose and resolve issues with third-party integrations (e.g., DocuSign, Microsoft 365, Salesforce, ERP/CRM systems).
* Analyze and troubleshoot Groovy scripts, custom workflows, and automation.
* Support and investigate blockchain-related transactions and document workflows (where applicable).
* Review application, server, and integration logs to identify root causes.
* Reproduce customer-reported issues in test environments.
* Work closely with Development, QA, DevOps, and Product teams on defect resolution.
* Create detailed bug reports, feature requests, and technical documentation.
* Develop and maintain knowledge base articles and troubleshooting guides.
* Assist customers with configuration, onboarding, and best practices.
* Monitor system performance and proactively identify recurring issues.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* REST APIs, JSON, XML
* Postman
* OAuth 2.0, JWT, API authentication
* Groovy scripting
* SQL (basic to intermediate)
* Webhooks
* Integration troubleshooting
* Blockchain concepts (if used by the application)
* DocuSign API and OAuth
* HTTP/HTTPS protocols and status codes
* Git/Jira/Confluence
* Log analysis and debugging
* Windows/Linux fundamentals
* Cloud-based SaaS environments (AWS/Azure/GCP is a plus)

**MUST HAVE**

* Experience with Groovy scripting or other scripting languages.
* Knowledge of DocuSign API and OAuth integrations.
* Basic to intermediate SQL skills for querying and validating data.

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience with Groovy scripting or other scripting languages.
* Knowledge of DocuSign API and OAuth integrations.
* Experience supporting blockchain-based applications or document workflows.
* Familiarity with Git and Confluence.
* Understanding of Linux/Unix and Windows environments.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps concepts.

Experience with monitoring and logging tools such as Splunk, Kibana, Grafana, or Datadog.

title: Script Producer
description:
About the role

We are looking for a Long-Form Research & Script Producer for YouTube videos. As

we ramp up, we are aiming for 8 to 10 videos a month. You will be the research and writing

engine behind them: testing new AI tools hands-on, finding the angles other creators miss,

and turning that into a script that is ready for review. The creator locks the angle before

you draft and do the final review.

What will you do

* Test new AI tools hands-on and write clear testing notes (what worked, what broke, what surprised you?)
* Dig up pro tips, workflows, and angles that other creators have not covered.
* For every long-form video, deliver a research document, 3 to 5 hook options, a structured outline, and a first-draft script.
* Write natural, conversational Hinglish scripts that sound like the creator, not like AI.
* Plan structure and retention: hook, pacing, pattern interrupts, payoff.
* Research beyond the first page of Google: communities, changelogs, docs, X, Reddit, GitHub, newsletters.
* Maintain organised documentation: a tools-tested log, a topic bank and a source library.
* Incorporate feedback quickly and keep the pipeline on schedule.
* Pass useful research and angles to the short-form team for repurposing.

Must have

* Uses AI tools daily and can show what they have tested recently.
* Writes natural Hinglish.
* Can explain why a YouTube video works: hook, structure, retention.
* Strong independent research habits.
* Uses ChatGPT or Claude well and can spot and fix generic AI output.
* Organised, documents their work, takes feedback well.

Good to have

* Experience writing for a tech or AI YouTube channel (a big plus).
* Basic understanding of YouTube analytics (CTR, average view duration, retention, graphs).
* Familiarity with no-code tools, automation, or light coding

Our expertise extends to multimodal transport solutions, customs clearance, port security, and environmental sustainability, positioning us as a key player in global trade and logistics.

Team Member - Dry Cargo Operations is responsible for assisting in all aspects of dry cargo operations, including stack yard management, railway operations, heavy equipment utilization, and vessel operations, align with the organization's goals. **Responsibilities**

* SAP, PR/PO Creation

* MIS, BRM and other Reports Preparation
* Customs Reports and Compliance
* Communication with Internal and External Parties for Reports, Cargo receipt and dispatch Reports, Gate Pass Entry, Documentation etc

**Required Skills**
**Dry Cargo Operational Oversight:**
Optimize the use of dumpers and equipment to minimize costs per metric ton for cargo shifting and equipment usage. Work according to planned yard activities in coordination with rake planning to minimize stoppages during vessel discharging.
  
  
**Cargo Quality Assurance**
Prevent the mixing of different cargo grades and contamination with foreign materials in the yard and during rake loading. Ensure adherence to General Dock Rules (GDR) and General Loading Rules (GLR) concerning contract conditions.

Ensure adherance to cost control measures and prevent financial losses due to cargo contamination, mix-ups, or non-achievement of GDR & GLR. Achieve cost savings through the reduction of variable equipment hires and efficient equipment utilization.
  
  
**Stack Yard Management**
Adhere to stack yard management plans to facilitate efficient cargo evacuation from mechanized plots and achieve targets set by management.
  
  
**Rake Utilization Efficiency**
Minimize rake demurrage, dead freight, and punitive charges through effective planning and coordination.
  
  
**Equipment Reconciliation**
Regularly reconcile equipment status with Operations & Maintenance (O&M) prior to loading and discharging operations. Ensure accurate reconciliation of customer stacks.
  
  
**Vendor Management**
Process bills, raise purchase requests as needed, follow up on payment processes for vendors, and coordinate customer field visits.

Keep up with digital and AI advancements to enhance business and maintain competitiveness.

title: Product & Business Operations Associate
description:
**PRODUCT & BUSINESS OPERATIONS ASSOCIATE**

**Ahmedabad, Gujarat**

**Full-time | On-site**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

SVECTOR is hiring a Product & Business Operations Associate to work across product, customer, research and business execution.

This role is designed for an early-career technical professional who wants to operate beyond a narrow software-development function and work across technology, product, customers, research and company-building.

You will work closely with the Founder-CEO and relevant functional teams on selected high-priority initiatives across SVECTOR.

This is not an administrative role.

You will be expected to understand problems, structure them, identify what needs to happen, coordinate the relevant people and carry assigned work through to a clear and verified result.

The role requires someone who can move comfortably between technical and business problems.

**WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON**

**1. PRODUCT & BUSINESS EXECUTION**

You will take ownership of assigned product and business initiatives.

Typical responsibilities may include:

• Understanding a customer, product or business problem before work begins

• Converting unclear requests into structured problem statements and requirements

• Defining expected outcomes, owners, dependencies and timelines

• Coordinating with Product, Engineering and business teams

• Identifying missing inputs and blockers

• Following work through rather than simply forwarding instructions

• Reviewing whether the delivered result actually solves the original problem

• Maintaining clear records of open issues, decisions and next actions

• Escalating decisions when authority or additional support is required

You should be comfortable taking an objective that is initially ambiguous and turning it into practical execution.

**2. PRODUCT UNDERSTANDING**

Strong product understanding is important for this role.

You may be expected to:

• Use SVECTOR products and understand important workflows

• Understand the intended user and customer problem

• Review customer feedback and product issues

• Distinguish between defects, requirements and new product requests

• Prepare product requirements and acceptance criteria

• Understand APIs, integrations, data flows and technical dependencies

• Follow technical discussions with engineers

• Participate in demos, pilots and implementation discussions

• Verify whether an agreed workflow is actually ready

You do not need to be a full-time software developer.

However, you should have enough technical understanding to work intelligently with engineers and enough business understanding to know why the technical work matters.

**3. RESEARCH & ANALYSIS**

Research will be an important part of the role.

You may investigate:

• Companies

• Customers

• Markets

• Competitors

• Technologies

• Industries

• Product opportunities

• Enterprise accounts

• Candidates

• Market-entry questions

• Commercial models

• Strategic business questions

Good research should clearly distinguish between:

• Verified facts

• Estimates

• Assumptions

• Interpretation

• Missing information

You should be comfortable reading original material, comparing conflicting evidence, checking numbers and explaining the business implication of what you find.

We do not want surface-level summaries.

We want someone who can enter an unfamiliar subject, understand it quickly and produce a useful conclusion.

**4. AI-NATIVE WORK**

This is an AI-native role.

You should already be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or equivalent systems for professional work.

You may use AI for:

• Research

• Document analysis

• Writing

• Data organization

• Summarization

• Workflow automation

• Structured analysis

• Repetitive work

• Product thinking

However, you remain responsible for every output.

You should be able to explain:

• What you asked the system to do

• Which sources were used

• What assumptions were made

• What the model got wrong

• What you corrected

• What remains uncertain

Copying an AI-generated answer without understanding or verifying it is not acceptable.

**5. CUSTOMER & COMMERCIAL WORK**

You may support selected customer and commercial initiatives.

This may include:

• Researching customers and accounts before meetings

• Understanding customer workflows and requirements

• Preparing meeting briefs and talking points

• Drafting customer communication and follow-ups

• Preparing product or commercial material

• Coordinating internal responses to customer questions

• Maintaining customer commitments and next steps

• Supporting demos, pilots and implementation discussions

• Following open issues through to a confirmed outcome

Sending a follow-up is not the outcome.

The expectation is to understand what needs to happen next and keep the work moving until there is a clear result or next state.

**6. HIRING & PEOPLE RESEARCH**

The role may also support selected hiring initiatives.

You may work on:

• Understanding why a role exists

• Preparing role briefs

• Researching candidates

• Reviewing candidate evidence

• Preparing interview material

• Comparing candidates

• Coordinating selected hiring processes

• Maintaining accurate hiring records and next steps

This is not an HR or Talent Acquisition position.

The objective is to support better hiring decisions using structured evidence.

**7. BUSINESS COMMUNICATION & MEETING PREPARATION**

You may prepare:

• Customer briefs

• Internal memos

• Research summaries

• Meeting notes

• Talking points

• Product requirements

• Candidate comparisons

• Proposal content

• Presentation outlines

• Follow-up communication

For important meetings, you may be expected to understand:

• Who is attending

• Prior correspondence

• Relevant documents

• Outstanding questions

• Previous commitments

• Intended meeting outcome

• Required next actions

When the same topic returns later, the relevant context should already be organized and available.

**8. OWNERSHIP STANDARD**

This role is built around ownership.

We do not consider the following to be completed work:

“I sent the message.”

“I followed up.”

“I informed the team.”

“I completed my part.”

The expected operating pattern is:

Understand the result.

Build the plan.

Get the required inputs.

Move the work.

Resolve blockers.

Escalate what genuinely requires a decision.

Check the final result.

Close the loop.

For important assignments, you should always know:

• What outcome is expected

• Who is responsible

• What information is missing

• What dependencies exist

• What deadline applies

• What could block completion

• What remains unresolved

• What decision is required

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are particularly interested in early-career candidates with a strong technical foundation.

Preferred educational backgrounds include:

• Computer Science

• Computer Engineering

• Information Technology

• Software Engineering

• Artificial Intelligence

• Related technical disciplines

Typically, we are looking for candidates with approximately 1 to 5 years of professional experience.

Exceptional recent graduates with strong evidence of ownership, technical ability, product thinking or real-world execution are also encouraged to apply.

Relevant backgrounds may include:

• Product

• Product Operations

• Business Analysis

• Technical Consulting

• Technical Pre-Sales

• Implementation

• Solutions

• Customer Success for technical products

• AI products

• Enterprise software

• Technical project execution

• Early-stage startup roles

**WHAT WE VALUE**

**HIGH OWNERSHIP**

You attempt solutions and move work forward without waiting for detailed instructions at every step.

**TECHNICAL FLUENCY**

You can understand software products, APIs, integrations, data flows and implementation constraints.

**PRODUCT THINKING**

You think about the user, customer problem, workflow and outcome, not only the feature.

**RESEARCH DEPTH**

You can independently investigate unfamiliar subjects and reach a reasoned conclusion.

**STRONG WRITING**

Your work should be clear, structured and usable without requiring complete rewriting.

**JUDGMENT**

You understand what you can handle independently and what genuinely requires escalation.

**RELIABILITY**

If you commit to something, it gets done, or the problem is raised before the deadline.

**LEARNING SPEED**

You can enter a new subject, ask precise questions and become useful quickly.

**AI FLUENCY**

You use modern AI tools seriously and understand how to verify their outputs.

**DISCRETION**

You will have access to company, customer, personnel and strategic information. Confidential information must remain confidential and be shared only with authorized people for legitimate company work.

**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**

This is not:

• A personal assistant role

• A calendar-management position

• An administrative support role

• A pure strategy job

• A pure research role

• A pure software-development role

• A conventional project coordinator position

• A role where work ends after forwarding an instruction

Personal errands, household matters and lifestyle management are outside the scope of this position.

**WORKING ARRANGEMENT**

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

Employment: Full-time

Work mode: On-site

The environment is fast-moving and priorities may change as customer, product and company requirements evolve.

You should be comfortable operating in ambiguity while creating structure around the work you own.

Important product, customer or company matters may occasionally require responsiveness outside normal working hours.

**SELECTION PROCESS**

We care more about actual ability than polished interview answers.

The selection process may include:

1. Initial conversation

2. Product or research exercise

3. Business writing / execution exercise

4. Final discussion

AI tools may be used during selected exercises.

Candidates will be expected to explain their reasoning, sources, assumptions, decisions and corrections.

If you are young, technically strong, curious about business, comfortable with AI, capable of learning quickly and want to work across product, customers and execution rather than remain inside one narrow function, we would like to hear from you.

title: Technical Content Strategist
description:

Greetings from
**Infinnium !**

We are hiring for the position of
**Technical Content Strategist**
to join our growing US-based IT company in Ahmedabad.

**Designation:**
**Technical Content Strategist**

**Location: Ahmedabad**

**Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site**

**Experience: 1 to 3 Years**

**About Company:**

Infinnium Infotech is redefining the way organizations engage with data to gain actionable intelligence. We develop software solutions for corporations, law firms, and government agencies using modern technologies such as AI and machine learning to support information governance, including compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, and other privacy regulations, litigation readiness, and electronic discovery.Our software product brings simplicity to the complex world of digital data, combining the strength of people and modern technology to help organizations effectively address today’s complex information governance needs and realize the intrinsic value of their data.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a Junior Technical Writer / Product Documentation Specialist to join our team and help create and maintain clear, accurate, and user-friendly product documentation.

The role involves working closely with Product, Development, QA, and Support teams to understand product functionality, UI changes, new features, enhancements, and workflows, and convert this information into comprehensive help documentation.

This role will be particularly important as we undergo a major UI transformation of the product, requiring significant documentation updates and new content within defined timelines. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with technical information, reviewing development stories, understanding application workflows, coordinating with technical teams, and using AI powered tools to improve documentation quality and efficiency.

**Role Summary :**

This position is ideal for a technically inclined writer who enjoys learning software products, collaborating with engineering and QA teams, and turning complex product functionality into clear, practical user documentation. Candidates who combine strong English communication skills with technical curiosity, attention to detail, and effective use of AI-assisted tools are encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Review TFS/Azure DevOps stories, requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical details to understand new features and product changes.
* Analyze existing and newly developed product functionality and understand end-to-end user workflows.
* Work closely with developers, QA/testers, product teams, and support teams to clarify functionality and documentation requirements.
* Participate in discussions, demonstrations, and walkthroughs with developers and testers to understand how features work in the actual product.
* Create and update product help files, user guides, feature documentation, configuration guides, and workflow documentation.
* Document new features and UI changes with clear, structured, and easy-to-understand explanations.
* Review the application UI and ensure documentation accurately reflects the latest screens, fields, buttons, options, workflows, and terminology.
* Identify gaps or inconsistencies between product functionality and existing documentation and coordinate with relevant teams for clarification.
* Document configuration options, prerequisites, permissions, limitations, dependencies, and expected behavior where applicable.
* Update existing documentation whenever product functionality, workflows, or UI elements change.
* Maintain consistency in terminology, formatting, structure, screenshots, and documentation standards across the product.
* Coordinate documentation updates with product releases and ensure documentation is completed within required timelines.
* Upload and publish completed documentation to the product/help system as required.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Excellent technical writing and documentation skills.
* Ability to understand software functionality and explain it in simple, user-friendly language.
* Experience working with software products, SaaS applications, or technical platforms.
* Ability to read and understand user stories, requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical discussions.
* Ability to work effectively with developers and QA/testers to understand functionality and validate documentation.
* Good understanding of software development and testing processes.

title: SEO Content Writer
description:
**SEO Content Writer**

**Company: Egrowth Partners Pvt Ltd**

**Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India**

**Type: Full-time (Work from Office)**

**Experience: 2 to 4 years**

**Salary: Up to 7 LPA (Based on skills & experience)**

**About us**

EGrowth Partners is the back office and growth team for print businesses in the USA, UK, Canada, Europe and Australia. We run order entry, pre-press, customer service and bookkeeping for printers, and build the websites and marketing that bring in their next job. Everyone on the team is trained in print before working on client accounts, so the role builds real industry expertise.

**About the role**

EGrowth Partners is hiring an SEO Content Writer to create content that ranks on Google, gets cited in AI answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews, and brings in leads. You'll work from SEO briefs, research each topic properly, and talk to subject experts when a piece needs real expertise.

Your readers will range from first-time searchers to people who know the subject well, so clear, plain writing matters more here than clever writing.

**What you'll do**

**Writing and publishing**

•     Write blogs, long-form guides, how-tos, comparison posts, service and landing pages, and FAQs from SEO briefs

•     Adjust tone and depth for each audience, and follow the style guide you're given

•     Write titles and meta descriptions that earn the click

•     Format and publish each piece yourself, with clean headings, internal links, images, and alt text

**Content Optimization**

•     Check search intent before you start writing, and shape the piece around what the searcher actually wants

•     Plan and optimize content in Frase, Surfer SEO, or Clearscope

•     Structure content so AI search tools can pull and cite it: direct answers near the top, question-based headings, short definitions, comparison tables, and FAQ sections

•     Build E-E-A-T into each piece with first-hand insight, expert quotes, credible sources, clear author details, and current facts

•     Work with the SEO team on internal linking, schema, and topic clusters

**Quality and expertise**

•     Interview subject matter experts and turn what they know into content a beginner can follow

•     Fact-check every claim and cite your sources

•     Turn technical topics into plain language most readers can follow on the first read, usually around a 6th to 8th grade reading level

•     Proofread and self-edit before anything goes to review

**Performance and updates**

•     Refresh older content that's losing rankings or has gone out of date

•     Check performance in Google Search Console and Google Analytics, and use it to decide what to fix next

•     Track where your content shows up in AI answers and rework what isn't getting picked up

**How we use AI**

You'll use AI tools for research, outlines, and first-pass ideas. The writing, judgment, fact-checking, and final quality are yours. Anything we publish has been written and checked by a person.

**How we measure success**

We look at rankings, organic traffic, AI search visibility, leads from your content, and how few edit rounds a piece needs before it goes live.

**What you'll bring**

•     2 to 4 years of SEO content writing for websites

•     A portfolio of published work, ideally with pieces that rank or have been cited in AI answers

•     Hands-on use of at least one content optimization tool (Frase, Surfer SEO, or Clearscope)

•     A solid grasp of search intent, on-page SEO, and E-E-A-T

•     Working knowledge of how AI search tools choose which sources to cite

•     Experience publishing in WordPress, Webflow, or Shopify

•     Strong written English (C1 or above) and sharp editing skills

•     Comfort working on your own and managing deadlines in a remote or hybrid team

**Nice to have**

•     Experience with other content optimization tools like MarketMuse, NeuronWriter, or Semrush SEO Writing Assistant

•     Experience writing for health, finance, or tech brands

•     Content that's earned backlinks or press mentions

•     Some sense of page layout and UX for content-heavy pages

•     A degree in English, journalism, communications, or marketing (a strong portfolio counts more)

**What we offer**

•     Competitive salary with annual performance reviews

•     Paid earned, casual, and sick leave, plus public holidays

•     Laptop and access to paid SEO and AI tools

**Our hiring process**

1.  A short screening call to talk through your experience and samples

2.  A test piece written to a real brief

3.  A final interview with the hiring manager

**How to apply**

Send your resume, a short cover letter, and 2 to 3 published writing samples to naveen@searchlogy.com

We’d like to see how you optimize, not only how you write. If you used Frase, Surfer SEO, Clearscope, or a similar tool on any sample, share that piece’s link, and your application moves to the front of the review queue.

EGrowth Partners is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and judge every application on skills and work.

title: Content Writer
description:
Job Description: Content Writer

**Company:**
Sapiogen AI Private Limited

**Department:**
Marketing & Growth

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Mode:**
On-site

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Experience:**
1–3 Years

About Sapiogen AI

Sapiogen AI is an
**AI-first software engineering company**
helping startups, scale-ups, and enterprises build intelligent software products, modernize technology, automate operations, and accelerate digital transformation.

Our capabilities include
**AI-powered product development, AI consulting, AI development, AI automation & RPA, conversational & voice AI, cloud engineering, data engineering, AI integration, and legacy modernization.**

We are building an international technology brand targeting clients across the
**USA, UK, Canada, Australia, and UAE**
.

About the Role

We are looking for a
**Content Writer**
who can create high-quality, technically credible, and conversion-focused content for Sapiogen AI.

The ideal candidate should be able to simplify complex topics such as
**AI, software engineering, cloud, automation, data, and digital transformation**
and turn them into content that attracts decision-makers, builds authority, supports SEO, and generates business interest.

This is not a generic blog-writing role. You will work closely with the
**SEO and marketing teams**
to create content designed for search engines, AI-powered search platforms, and real business audiences.

Key ResponsibilitiesContent Creation

* Write high-quality blogs, articles, website pages, service pages, landing pages, case studies, and thought-leadership content.
* Create content around AI, software engineering, automation, cloud, data, digital transformation, and emerging technologies.
* Write content that is informative, engaging, authoritative, and aligned with Sapiogen AI's positioning.
* Convert complex technical concepts into clear and easy-to-understand business content.
* Create content for international B2B audiences, particularly decision-makers, founders, CTOs, CIOs, and technology leaders.
* Develop content that communicates business outcomes rather than simply describing technical features.

SEO Content

* Work closely with the SEO Executive/Manager to create keyword-focused content.
* Conduct basic keyword and competitor research to understand search intent.
* Naturally incorporate primary, secondary, and long-tail keywords.
* Create SEO-friendly titles, headings, meta descriptions, FAQs, and content structures.
* Develop content around commercial, informational, and transactional search intent.
* Optimize existing content based on SEO performance and ranking opportunities.
* Support the creation of topic clusters and topical authority around AI and software engineering.

AI Search, AEO & GEO

* Create content optimized for emerging AI-powered search experiences.
* Understand
  **Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)**
  and
  **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**
  principles.
* Structure content to provide clear, direct, authoritative answers to relevant questions.
* Create FAQ, comparison, definition, use-case, and problem-solution content that can be useful in AI search experiences.
* Maintain strong factual accuracy and avoid producing generic AI-generated content.
* Use AI tools as productivity assistants while ensuring the final content demonstrates human judgment, originality, and expertise.

Website & Conversion Content

* Write and optimize service pages such as:
* AI Consulting
* AI Product Development
* AI Development
* AI Automation
* Conversational AI
* Voice AI
* Cloud Engineering
* Data Engineering
* Legacy Modernization
* Create industry-specific and use-case landing pages.
* Develop content that communicates Sapiogen AI's differentiation and encourages visitors to take action.
* Write website CTAs, headlines, value propositions, FAQs, and supporting copy.
* Ensure content aligns with Sapiogen AI's brand voice and premium positioning.

Research & Thought Leadership

* Research emerging trends, technologies, market developments, and customer challenges.
* Create thought-leadership articles and opinion-driven content around AI and software engineering.
* Analyze competitor content and identify content gaps and opportunities.
* Interview internal technical experts when necessary to develop technically accurate content.
* Support whitepapers, guides, reports, newsletters, and other long-form content initiatives.

Content Distribution

* Create content for LinkedIn and other relevant social platforms.
* Repurpose blogs and long-form content into LinkedIn posts, carousels, short-form content, and other marketing assets.
* Support email newsletters and campaign content.
* Collaborate with the design team to create content briefs for visual assets.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 1–3 years of experience in content writing, preferably in
  **B2B technology, SaaS, IT services, AI, or software engineering**
  .
* Excellent written English and strong grammar.
* Strong research and fact-checking abilities.
* Ability to explain technical concepts in simple business language.
* Understanding of SEO fundamentals and search intent.
* Familiarity with keyword research and content optimization.
* Basic understanding of Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Ahrefs, Semrush, or similar tools is an advantage.
* Understanding of AI, software development, cloud computing, automation, or digital transformation is preferred.
* Ability to write for international audiences, particularly US and UK markets.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.
* Ability to independently research topics and produce original content.

Preferred Skills

* Experience writing for technology companies or IT service companies.
* Knowledge of
  **AEO, GEO, AI search, and content marketing**
  .
* Understanding of B2B lead-generation content.
* Experience creating service pages and landing pages designed for conversions.
* Familiarity with WordPress or modern CMS platforms.
* Experience using AI writing/research tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Perplexity.
* Ability to collaborate with SEO specialists, developers, designers, and marketing teams.

What We Expect

We are looking for a writer who can move beyond generic "AI-generated" articles.

Your content should be:

**Research-driven → Technically accurate → Human-written → SEO-friendly → Business-focused → Conversion-oriented.**

You should be able to take a topic such as
**"AI Agent Development for Enterprises"**
and create content that not only ranks in search but also makes a CTO or business leader understand
**why they need it, where it can create value, what implementation involves, and why Sapiogen AI is the right engineering partner.**

Key Performance Indicators

* Quality and consistency of published content.
* Organic visibility and ranking improvement of content.
* Growth in organic traffic and relevant search impressions.
* Engagement and time spent on content.
* Contribution to qualified organic leads and enquiries.
* Number of high-quality content assets delivered on schedule.
* Improvement of existing underperforming content.
* Growth of Sapiogen AI's topical authority across AI and software engineering subjects.

Why Join Sapiogen AI?

* Opportunity to work with an
  **AI-first technology company**
  from an early stage.
* Exposure to AI, software engineering, cloud, automation, and emerging technologies.
* Opportunity to build content for international markets.
* Work closely with SEO, marketing, engineering, and leadership teams.
* Learn and work on emerging areas such as
  **AI Search, AEO, GEO, and AI-assisted content marketing**
  .
* Opportunity for career growth as the marketing organization expands.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a
**strong researcher and storyteller**
who understands technology and can turn complex technical subjects into compelling business content.

If you are passionate about technology, AI, SEO, and storytelling—and want to build content that contributes directly to the growth of an international technology company—we'd love to hear from you.

**Apply now to join Sapiogen AI and help us build the future of AI-first software engineering.**

At Digital Reach, we design and manufacture cutting-edge IoT gateways integrated with advanced software dashboards for the industrial and energy sectors. or apply directly on LinkedIn.

title: Assistant Manager - Environment
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
To assist in executing detailed project plans, managing budgets, monitoring project progress, and analyzing performance metrics. This role involves supporting the planning and control processes, ensuring compliance with timelines and budgets, and coordinating with internal teams to facilitate smooth project execution.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Environmental Compliance Support**

* Assist in the development and maintenance of the Environment Management System to align with regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with regulatory bodies to facilitate the acquisition of necessary environmental permits and clearances.
* Support the process of obtaining Consents to Establish (CTO) and ensure compliance with environmental regulations during project execution.

**Communication and Coordination**

* Work closely with internal departments and external stakeholders to gather necessary data for environmental reporting.
* Assist in the preparation and submission of compliance reports to regulatory agencies, ensuring timely and accurate documentation.
* Coordinate and facilitate site inspections by regulatory authorities, ensuring all findings and observations are addressed.

**Monitoring and Reporting**

* Conduct air, water, and soil quality monitoring as per statutory requirements using the prescribed methods and equipment.
* Prepare and submit environmental monitoring reports, including monthly, quarterly, and annual updates, to the Environment Lead and relevant authorities.
* Assist in the development of Management Information System (MIS) reports to track environmental performance metrics.

**Audit and Maintenance Support**

* Support the conduct of internal environmental audits, helping to identify gaps and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure that environmental monitoring equipment is maintained and calibrated regularly for accurate data collection.
* Participate in safety inspections within the mining area and assist in updating safety observations in the relevant systems.

**Documentation and Digital Dexterity**

* Assist in the documentation of all environmental compliance activities in the company's environmental management software (e.g., Legatrix).
* Ensure that all records, reports, and documentation are accurately maintained and easily accessible for audits and inspections.
* Support the Environment Lead in managing environmental expenditure as per the approved budget.
* Utilize assigned digital tools and software to complete daily tasks accurately and efficiently.
* Continuously upskill in emerging digital technologies relevant to the role.

**Internal Stakeholders**
Business Head, Engineering, Horticulture, Safety, Projects
  
  
**External Stakeholders**
Pollution control board officials, Forest and environment department officials
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Education Qualification**
BE-Chemical/ B.E. Environment / M.Sc. Environment
  
  
**Work Experience**
3– 5 years of relevant experience

title: Customer Support Executive
description:
# Job Description: Customer Support Executive

About Us :

Futuristic Climate Controls Pvt. Ltd. (www.futuristicclimatecontrols.in) is a premier distributor and stockist of industrial process instrumentation, sensors, and HVAC control systems based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. Since 2008, we have partnered with global industry leaders like Honeywell, Wika, Baumer to supply high-precision transmitters, Switches gauges, and automation controls to industrial clients nationwide.

---

Position Title: Customer Support Executive

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

Experience Required 1 – 10 Years

Industry Preference: Industrial Instrumentation / Process Automation / HVAC Controls

### Job Overview

We are looking for a customer-focused Customer Support Executive to manage post-sales technical support from our Ahmedabad office. The ideal candidate will have prior experience supporting clients in the industrial instrumentation and automation sector, handling queries regarding Pressure, Temperature, Flow, Level, and HVAC Transmitters, Switches, and Gauges. You will be responsible for providing prompt solutions, maintaining high client satisfaction, and resolving order or product issues efficiently.

### Key Responsibilities

\* Technical Assistance: Handle incoming client calls, emails, and online inquiries regarding product installation, Wiring, Integration with other instruments or any other query post sales.

\* Issue & Complaint Resolution: Address client grievances, coordinate replacement/repair requests or returns according to company policies, and ensure minimal downtime for the customer.

\* Feedback & Relationship Maintenance: Collect customer feedback, follow up after delivery to ensure product performance, and maintain long-term positive client relationships.

\* Record Keeping: Update and maintain customer interaction logs, feedback reports, and complaint resolution histories

### Qualifications & Key Skills

\* Domain Knowledge: 1 to 10 years of experience in customer support or client coordination, preferably within industrial instrumentation, sensors, or HVAC equipment.

\* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, Hindi, and Gujarati.

\* Problem-Solving Ability: Strong analytical and conflict-resolution skills to resolve customer issues calmly and quickly.

\* Tools & Software: Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel) and Tally Prime/ERP9

Please share your CV to rajesh.garg@futuristicclimatecontrols.in

title: Founder's Associate
description:
**About TAFCO**

TAFCO is India’s first Integrated Indoor Air Quality (IAQ) Solutions company focused on assessing, managing, and improving indoor air quality across residential, commercial, and industrial environments. TAFCO is positioned beyond selling individual products and provides end-to-end IAQ solutions, combining monitoring, data analysis, solution deployment, and ongoing performance management to deliver healthier indoor environments in residential, commercial, and industrial setups. Recently, we have received funding under the SISFS (GoI) scheme and are a DPIIT-recognized & incubated startup at GUSEC, Ahmedabad.

**Who this is for**

* Someone who wants to grow into a leadership role in the startup/cleantech space, or build their own company one day
* Genuinely curious about air quality, cleantech, and building a category-defining brand in India
* Highly organized — able to take a messy, undefined problem and run with it alone once the goal is clear
* Comfortable owning numbers (budgets, MIS) as much as people (hiring, vendors, coordination)

**You will**

* Work closely with the founder (almost shadow) to move high-priority operational and financial workstreams forward independently
* Own MIS reporting, budgets, and day-to-day financial admin
* Scout and coordinate hiring — sourcing candidates, running interview logistics, closing loops
* Coordinate vendors, compliance, and administrative operations
* Take on special projects that don't yet have an owner
* Take up client discovery calls and formulate actions for onboarding regional partners
* Prepare curated investment decks for angels and VCs

**You are**

* An engineer (any stream) with 0-3 years of experience working in a startup (hardware preferably)
* Enthusiastic about learning new things and never shy of approaching a problem to find a solution
* A person who enjoys keeping multiple tabs open at all times and multitasking to sort things, however, finds calm in the chaos
* Someone who understands the problem of air pollution and is ready to create an impact

*This is not a remote job and the selected candidate needs to work from our Ahmedabad office or travel with the Founder. We have a 6-day working week.*

**Salary range : 3.5 ~ 4LPA (Incentives + potential ESOPs in future)**

Please write to us at careers@tafco.in once you have applied here by introducing yourself briefly and focusing more on your pitch for this role.

description:

Greetings from
**Infinnium !**

We are hiring for the position of Technical Writer – Product Documentation to join our growing US-based IT company in Ahmedabad.

**Designation: Technical Writer – Product Documentation**

**Location: Ahmedabad**

**Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site**

**Openings: 2**

**About Company:**

**Infinnium Infotech**
is redefining the way organizations engage with data to gain actionable intelligence. We develop software solutions for corporations, law firms, and government agencies using modern technologies such as AI and machine learning to support information governance, including compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, and other privacy regulations, litigation readiness, and electronic discovery.Our software product brings simplicity to the complex world of digital data, combining the strength of people and modern technology to help organizations effectively address today’s complex information governance needs and realize the intrinsic value of their data.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a Technical Writer / Product Documentation Specialist to join our team and help create and maintain clear, accurate, and user-friendly product documentation.The role involves working closely with Product, Development, QA, and Support teams to understand product functionality, UI changes, new features, enhancements, and workflows, and convert this information into comprehensive help documentation.

This role will be particularly important as we undergo a major UI transformation of the product, requiring significant documentation updates and new content within defined timelines. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with technical information, reviewing development stories, understanding application workflows, coordinating with technical teams, and using AI powered tools to improve documentation quality and efficiency.

**Role Summary :**

This position is ideal for a technically inclined writer who enjoys learning software products, collaborating with engineering and QA teams, and turning complex product functionality into clear, practical user documentation. Candidates who combine strong English communication skills with technical curiosity, attention to detail, and effective use of AI-assisted tools are encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Review TFS/Azure DevOps stories, requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical details to understand new features and product changes.
* Analyze existing and newly developed product functionality and understand end-to-end user workflows.
* Work closely with developers, QA/testers, product teams, and support teams to clarify functionality and documentation requirements.
* Participate in discussions, demonstrations, and walkthroughs with developers and testers to understand how features work in the actual product.
* Create and update product help files, user guides, feature documentation, configuration guides, and workflow documentation.
* Document new features and UI changes with clear, structured, and easy-to-understand explanations.
* Review the application UI and ensure documentation accurately reflects the latest screens, fields, buttons, options, workflows, and terminology.
* Identify gaps or inconsistencies between product functionality and existing documentation and coordinate with relevant teams for clarification.
* Document configuration options, prerequisites, permissions, limitations, dependencies, and expected behavior where applicable.
* Update existing documentation whenever product functionality, workflows, or UI elements change.
* Maintain consistency in terminology, formatting, structure, screenshots, and documentation standards across the product.
* Coordinate documentation updates with product releases and ensure documentation is completed within required timelines.
* Upload and publish completed documentation to the product/help system as required.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Excellent technical writing and documentation skills.
* Ability to understand software functionality and explain it in simple, user-friendly language.
* Experience working with software products, SaaS applications, or technical platforms.
* Ability to read and understand user stories, requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical discussions.
* Ability to work effectively with developers and QA/testers to understand functionality and validate documentation.
* Good understanding of software development and testing processes.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when documenting UI elements, workflows, configurations, and system behavior.
* Familiarity with TFS/Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar work-management tools.
* Experience with documentation/help-authoring tools or knowledge bases.
* Experience with screenshots, screen annotation, flow diagrams, and other visual documentation.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and similar productivity tools.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or equivalent tools.

**Apply Here:**

https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/1hGjZ99xUj

**Thanks & Regards,**

**Yamini Patel**

**Infinnium**

Job Title: Head / Team Leader – Training (Injection Molding Business)
   

  

 Location: Ahmedabad, or as per business requirements
   

  

 Department: Technical Training / Sales Enablement / Customer Success
   

  

 Job Summary: Build, lead, and scale a structured training function for internal teams and customers, focusing on technical excellence, customer capability, and commercialization of training programs in injection molding and plastics processing.
   

  

 Education: BE/B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, or Polymer Engineering; MBA preferred
   

  

 Experience: 10\+ years in the injection molding industry, with proven leadership exposure
   

  

**Managerial Skills**
 Proven experience in the following areas:
   

  

* Training and capability development
* Revenue generation and business development
* Technical Skills:
* Strong knowledge of injection molding machines and processes
* Knowledge of plastic processing technologies, including extrusion and blow molding, will be an added advantage
* Commercial understanding with the ability to support revenue growth
* Functional Skills:
* Program and project management, including scheduling and Gantt chart planning
* Strong techno\-commercial acumen
* Development of technical and commercial training content
* Business planning with a focus on revenue generation
* Behavioral Competencies:
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills
* Strategic mindset with a strong execution focus
* Ability to influence and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams


**Key Responsibilities**
* Define and implement training strategies, frameworks, and certification pathways
* Deliver technical training to Sales \& Service teams; track effectiveness
* Design and conduct customer training (onsite, workshops, webinars)
* Develop technical \& sales enablement content (manuals, videos, SOPs, etc.)
* Build and monetize training programs (certifications, paid workshops, annual plans)
* Collaborating with Sales, Service, and Marketing for program execution and revenue growth
* Manage training schedules, resources, and delivery quality


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
* Year\-on\-year growth of the training function
* Number of Paid training programs.
* Customer participation levels and feedback scores
* Sales \& Service teams capability improvement
* Quality and output of training content


 Ideal Candidate: A techno\-commercial leader with strong domain expertise in plastics processing and a passion for building scalable, high\-impact training programs.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Milacron is a global industrial leader in the manufacturing and distribution of highly engineered and customized injection molding and extrusion solutions, and aftermarket parts and service for the plastics processing industry. The company’s 1,900\+ associates worldwide collaborate to serve a diverse range of end\-markets, such as automotive, construction, medical, telecommunications, material handling, packaging, and much more. With expertise in plastics spanning nearly 60 years, Milacron holds longstanding relationships with more than 27,000 customers around the world. The original equipment provider of plastics manufacturing solutions is the largest US\-owned and globally served of its kind. Headquartered in Batavia, OH, Milacron’s global footprint is also serviced through regional facilities in Asia, Europe, and South America.

 Lead the establishment and deployment of end\-to\-end Design Controls and Design History File (DHF) capabilities for medical device hardware, software, SaMD, connected platforms, and combination products. Own design control architecture, DHF frameworks, quality engineering integration, risk management, standards compliance, and regulatory traceability aligned to ISO 13485, CDSCO MDR, FDA 21 CFR 820/QMSR, EU MDR, IEC 62304, IEC 60601, ISO 14971, IEC 62366 and related standards.

 • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biomedical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Software, Systems Engineering or related field.

 • Experience with hardware, embedded software, digital health or connected medical devices.

 ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 62304, IEC 62366\-1, IEC 60601 family, FDA 21 CFR 820/QMSR, EU MDR 2017/745, CDSCO Medical Device Rules, cybersecurity and applicable biocompatibility and sterilization standards.

 • Regulatory Affairs Certifications (RAPS preferred).

**Core Competencies** 




 Systems Engineering, Requirements Management, Traceability, Risk Management, Product Safety, Verification \& Validation, Regulatory Compliance, Design Reviews, Audit Readiness, Technical Documentation, Cross\-functional Influencing, Problem Solving.
 



**Success Measures** 




 Establishment of a scalable Design Controls capability; Audit\-ready DHFs; Successful regulatory submissions; Traceability coverage across lifecycle artifacts; On\-time design reviews; Effective risk management and standards compliance.

title: Senior SQA Engineer (Supplier Technical Support)
description:
****New Supplier Development \& Technical Onboarding****
* Serve as the primary technical interface and resident expert at new supplier sites during the launch and qualification phases of new programmes.
* Lead on\-site technical readiness assessments and gap analyses against IATF 16949, APQP, and customer\-specific requirements (CSRs).
* Drive PPAP submission quality by coaching suppliers through Part Submission Warrant (PSW), process flow, PFMEA, control plans, and MSA.
* Establish and validate manufacturing process capability (Cpk/Ppk) and oversee first\-off and first\-article inspection activities.
* Develop and execute structured supplier onboarding programmes aligned to internal quality gates and product launch milestones.


****Hands\-On Technical Training \& Knowledge Transfer****
* Deliver applied, shop\-floor\-based training in core automotive quality systems: APQP, FMEA (AIAG\-VDA), Control Plans, SPC, MSA, and 8D problem\-solving.
* Train supplier personnel in product\-specific technical requirements including drawing interpretation, GD\&T, material specifications, and functional performance criteria.
* Design and facilitate workshops tailored to the supplier's technology base — with particular depth in electronics and PCBA: SMT processes, soldering quality, IPC standards, AOI/AXI interpretation, and ESD control.
* Mentor supplier quality engineers and technicians in root cause analysis tools (Ishikawa, 5\-Why, Is/Is\-Not, Shainin) and corrective action disciplines.
* Build internal supplier capability in layered process audits (LPA) and mistake\-proofing (poka\-yoke) methodologies.


****Electronics \& PCBA Technical Specialisation****
* Provide expert technical oversight at electronics and PCBA suppliers covering SMT, wave soldering, selective soldering, and through\-hole assembly processes.
* Assess and validate soldering quality against IPC\-A\-610 (Acceptability of Electronic Assemblies) and IPC\-J\-STD\-001 standards; coach supplier inspection teams in correct application.
* Evaluate bare PCB suppliers for compliance with IPC\-6012 / IPC\-A\-600 and review first article inspection of boards including impedance, via integrity, and surface finish.
* Review and validate electronic PFMEA and control plans for critical failure modes: solder bridges, opens, tombstoning, cold joints, pad cratering, and component orientation.
* Support qualification of new solder pastes, fluxes, and process chemistries; oversee SPC implementation on key process parameters (reflow profile, paste deposit, AOI escape rate).
* Drive appropriate use of automated optical inspection (AOI), automated X\-ray inspection (AXI/3D\-CT), and in\-circuit test (ICT) within supplier quality gates.
* Assess electrostatic discharge (ESD) controls, traceability, and handling procedures in line with ANSI/ESD S20\.20 requirements.
* Evaluate conformal coating processes (acrylic, silicone, polyurethane) for automotive environmental requirements including humidity, thermal cycling, and vibration resistance.
* Review component qualification evidence and manage supplier response to obsolescence, counterfeiting risk (AS6081\), and counterfeit avoidance controls.
* Support suppliers in establishing or strengthening quality management systems compliant with IATF 16949 and ISO 9001\.
* Conduct and lead formal second\-party audits including System, Process, and Product audits with documented findings and corrective action follow\-through.
* Identify systemic process risks and develop targeted improvement plans using lean and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Champion continuous improvement initiatives at supplier sites using structured problem\-solving and data\-driven approaches.


****Stakeholder Interface \& Reporting****
* Act as the primary liaison between the supplier site team and internal commodity, programme, and engineering stakeholders.
* Provide structured written progress reports, site visit summaries, and supplier scorecards to SQA leadership.
* Escalate product or process concerns with urgency and recommended containment actions.
* Participate in cross\-functional team (CFT) reviews, supplier business reviews, and APQP gate reviews.
