title: Project Coordinator - Rooftop
description:
**Job Summary**
 The Residential Solar Execution Executive will be responsible for conducting technical site surveys, ensuring installation quality, and managing the field execution of residential rooftop solar projects across Ahmedabad. The role involves assessing customer sites, coordinating with installation teams, monitoring project progress, and ensuring successful commissioning of solar systems while maintaining high standards of quality and customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Technical Site Survey \& System Design
   

  

* Conduct site surveys for residential rooftop solar projects.
* Assess roof dimensions, structure, shading analysis, and electrical infrastructure.
* Evaluate customer load requirements and determine appropriate system sizing.
* Prepare accurate Bills of Materials (BOM) and component requirements.
* Identify technical challenges and recommend suitable installation solutions.


 Project Execution \& Coordination
   

  

* Coordinate with installation teams to ensure timely project execution.
* Monitor project schedules and track installation progress.
* Ensure availability of required materials and equipment at project sites.
* Resolve on\-site technical issues and support installation teams during execution.


 Quality Assurance \& Inspection
   

  

* Review installation photos and videos submitted by field teams.
* Verify module mounting structures, inverter installations, cabling, earthing, and safety compliance.
* Conduct quality checks at various stages of project execution.
* Approve installations and provide technical sign\-off upon successful completion.


 Commissioning \& Customer Handover
   

  

* Support final testing and commissioning of solar power systems.
* Ensure systems are functioning as per design specifications.
* Coordinate customer handover and provide basic operational guidance.
* Assist in resolving post\-installation technical concerns.


 Documentation \& Compliance
   

  

* Maintain project records, survey reports, and installation documentation.
* Assist with net\-metering technical documentation and utility submission requirements.
* Ensure compliance with company quality standards and safety guidelines.


**Required Qualifications**
* Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Renewable Energy, or related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in solar project execution, site surveys, or rooftop solar installations.
* Freshers with strong technical knowledge of solar systems may also apply.


**Required Skills**
* Knowledge of rooftop solar system design and installation.
* Understanding of electrical systems, inverter technologies, and net\-metering processes.
* Ability to read technical drawings and single\-line diagrams.
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Good communication and coordination abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and reporting tools.
* Willingness to travel extensively within Ahmedabad for site visits.

title: SENIOR PROJECT COORDINATOR
description:
**ABOUT US:**




  





 Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India’s first private\-sector satellite mass\-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high\-volume manufacturing.
 



  





 As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end\-to\-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don’t just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost\-effective, high\-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you’ll be fuelling the future of space exploration.
 



  





  





**JOB SUMMARY:**




  





 As a Senior Project Coordinator within our Project Management Office (PMO), you will act as the operational backbone for active satellite manufacturing and mission delivery cycles. Partnering directly with Project Managers and engineering leads, you will drive execution discipline, eliminate cross\-functional bottlenecks, and ensure mission milestones transition seamlessly from CAD models to cleanroom assembly and launch manifests.
 



  





 Your core operational mandate is predictability: maintaining airtight milestone tracking, accelerating internal procurement loops, and ensuring documentation meets rigorous aerospace standards. In this role, your success will be measured by on\-time milestone delivery rates (OTD), schedule variance reduction, and data accuracy across our PMO toolstack.
 



  





  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**




  




* **Drive Schedule \& Milestone Integrity:** 
 Partner with Project Managers to maintain comprehensive work\-breakdown structures (WBS), track critical\-path deliverables, and flag schedule variances before they impact integration timelines.
* **Streamline Cross\-Functional Alignment:** 
 Serve as the day\-to\-day liaison between systems engineering, cleanroom manufacturing, quality assurance, procurement, and external launch partners.
* **Lead PMO Governance \& Meeting Cadence:** 
 Own sprint ceremonies, technical review agendas, and cross\-team standups; capture high\-signal minutes of meeting (MoM) and aggressively drive action\-item closure.
* **Maintain Technical Documentation \& Metrics:** 
 Centralize technical baseline documents, flight readiness paperwork, and engineering change requests (ECRs) while building real\-time status dashboards for executive review.
* **Proactive Risk \& Blocker Resolution:** 
 Surface manufacturing delays, component lead\-time anomalies, and integration risks early; run root\-cause follow\-ups to implement mitigation strategies.
* **Coordinate Technical Procurement \& Logistics:** 
 Expedite technical purchase requisitions (PR/PO workflows) for mission\-critical parts and coordinate precision logistics for aerospace\-grade hardware and testing campaigns.



  





  





**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR ?**




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Aerospace, Mechanical, Electronics, or similar) or Business Administration/Operations Management.
* 1–2 years of hands\-on project coordination or PMO experience in a fast\-paced, engineering\- or manufacturing\-driven environment.
* Working proficiency with industry\-standard project tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Microsoft Project, Asana, or ClickUp).
* Strong analytical and organizational skills, with a track record of managing multiple competing deadlines without dropping operational details.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, comfortable interfacing with senior engineering specialists and external vendors.



  





  





**NICE\-TO\-HAVES:**




  




* Prior exposure to the Space, Aerospace, Defense, or Precision Hardware Manufacturing sectors.
* Foundational understanding of satellite subsystems, avionics, payload integration, or cleanroom manufacturing workflows.
* Familiarity with hardware product lifecycle stages (PDR, CDR, TRR, and flight integration).



  





  





**WHY JOIN US ?**




  




* **Front\-Row Seat to the NewSpace Revolution:** 
 Work on physical flight hardware destined for orbit from India’s first commercial satellite mass\-production hub.
* **Accelerated Career Trajectory:** 
 Receive hands\-on mentorship from veteran aerospace program managers, developing deep domain expertise across space mission lifecycles.
* **High\-Impact, Zero\-Red\-Tape Culture:** 
 Experience the speed of a high\-growth tech disruptor paired with the manufacturing infrastructure of an aerospace leader.
* **Collaborative Ecosystem:** 
 Join an ambitious, multidisciplinary team of space enthusiasts, engineers, and builders dedicated to making space accessible globally.

1. Graduation with good grades from a reputed academic institution

title: Process Integration Development (PID) Engineer – Advanced interconnect (MEOL/BEOL) Integration
description:
Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components.
 



 Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India's first AI\-enabled state\-of\-the\-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high\-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence.
 



 Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata Group. The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission "To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust."
 



  





**Job Description** 




 We are seeking an experienced Process Integration Development (PID) Engineer – MEOL/BEOL Integration for advanced CMOS technologies at 28nm and below, including FinFET nodes. This role is responsible for driving advanced CMOS Process Integration Development, with primary ownership of advanced interconnects (MEOL/BEOL) process integration, enabling technology development, device performance optimization, yield enhancement, and manufacturing readiness.
 



 The successful candidate will drive advanced MEOL/BEOL process integration while working across MEOL/BEOL integration, process\-device interactions, silicon characterization, DOE development, process optimization, technology qualification, technology transfer, and high\-volume manufacturing ramp. The role requires close collaboration with Process Module, Device, Yield, Reliability, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams.
 



 At Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL), the Technology Development organization is responsible for developing, qualifying, and transferring various technology platforms from R\&D into high\-volume manufacturing, enabling world\-class semiconductor technologies and manufacturing excellence.
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Own advanced interconnect (MEOL/BEOL) process integration for advanced CMOS technologies (28nm and below), including silicide formation, self\-aligned contacts (SAC), local interconnects, via integration, Cu dual\-damascene processing, low\-k dielectric integration, barrier/liner engineering, RC optimization, and interconnect reliability to achieve target device performance, manufacturability, and reliability.
* Develop and optimize CMOS Process Integration technologies for 28nm and below technology nodes by driving process\-device interactions, DOE\-driven silicon learning, process characterization, and process window optimization.
* Analyze process integration trade\-offs using strong semiconductor device physics to optimize transistor characteristics, including Vt, Id, Ioff, DIBL, SS, mobility, matching, variability, and reliability, while achieving target device performance and manufacturability.
* Support technology qualification, technology transfer, manufacturing readiness, and production ramp activities, enabling successful transition from R\&D into high\-volume manufacturing.
* Drive manufacturing excellence through defect reduction, process capability enhancement, process robustness, and yield ramp activities using SPC, Cp/Cpk analysis, defect Pareto analysis, excursion investigations, and root\-cause analysis to improve process stability, device performance, and yield.
* Establish process\-to\-device and yield correlations through analysis of inline metrology, WAT/PCM, electrical characterization, defectivity, physical analysis, reliability, and yield data to identify integration risks, process sensitivities, and process optimization opportunities.
* Utilize DOE, TCAD, JMP, Python, statistical analysis, and advanced data analytics (AI/ML methodologies) to accelerate technology learning, process optimization, and yield enhancement. Experience with one or more of these tools is a plus.
* Collaborate with Device, Process Module, Yield, Reliability, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams to drive device characterization, reliability qualification, yield improvement, technology transfer, and production ramp.
* Provide technical expertise to solve complex process integration challenges while driving innovation, continuous improvement, and manufacturing excellence.



**Essential Attributes** 



* Strong expertise in advanced CMOS Process Integration for 28nm and below technology nodes, with solid understanding of MEOL and BEOL integration, process\-device interactions, and semiconductor manufacturing.
* Demonstrated expertise in advanced interconnect (MEOL/BEOL) process integration, including silicide formation, self\-aligned contacts (SAC), local interconnect integration, via integration, Cu dual\-damascene processing, low\-k dielectric integration, barrier/liner engineering, RC optimization, and interconnect reliability.
* Hands\-on experience in 28nm planar CMOS or more advanced logic technology nodes. Experience with FinFET technology, advanced interconnect integration, advanced patterning, and next\-generation device architectures is a plus.
* Strong semiconductor device physics foundation with the ability to optimize transistor performance parameters such as Vt, Id, Ioff, DIBL, SS, mobility, variability, matching, reliability, and manufacturability through process integration.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with proven experience in DOE development, process characterization, statistical analysis, process window optimization, silicon learning, and root\-cause analysis of process, device, yield, and reliability issues.
* Proven experience in technology qualification, technology transfer, manufacturing readiness, and production ramp, enabling successful transition from R\&D into high\-volume manufacturing.
* Demonstrated track record in yield improvement, defect reduction, SPC, Cp/Cpk enhancement, excursion management, process robustness, and high\-volume manufacturing support for advanced semiconductor technologies.
* Ability to correlate inline metrology, WAT/PCM, electrical characterization, defectivity, physical analysis, reliability, and yield data to identify integration risks, process sensitivities, and process optimization opportunities.
* Experience with TCAD, JMP, Python, statistical tools, and advanced data analytics (AI/ML methodologies) is a plus.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills with Device, Process Module, Yield, Reliability, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams.
* Strong communication, technical presentation, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to drive innovation, continuous improvement, and technical decision\-making in a fast\-paced semiconductor technology development environment.



**Qualifications** 



* M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Semiconductor Engineering, or related field with 3\+ to 10 years of experience.
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Semiconductor Engineering, or related field with 7\+ to 15 years of experience.
* Experience in 28nm planar CMOS, FinFET, or advanced logic technologies.
* Strong understanding of semiconductor device physics, process integration, DOE, statistical analysis, yield analysis, and process optimization.
* Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
